items.summary: The article examines 'Industry 5.0' and how this framework integrates human expertise with artificial intelligence in industrial applications.

items.title: The Unglamorous Work Behind Enterprise AI
items.summary: The article discusses the practical, often 'unglamorous' work involved in implementing and operating AI tools within enterprise settings.

items.title: AI broke the job application. What replaces it?
items.summary: The article discusses how the use of AI by job candidates for creating resumes and cover letters is forcing businesses to rethink their hiring processes.

items.title: Neurosymbolic Routing for Reliable Reasoning on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices
items.summary: This research explores methods for reliable reasoning using small language models on resource-constrained edge devices, addressing challenges in tasks like arithmetic and logic.

items.title: Is Human-Readable Text Necessary for Effective LLM Fine-Tuning?
items.summary: This paper investigates whether human-readable text is essential for effective LLM fine-tuning, proposing a new method (DASA) that uses non-human-readable training representations.

items.title: Self-discovering RL in the Era of Experience: Is Learning History an Asset or a Burden?
items.summary: This paper investigates recursive self-improvement in AI, particularly within reinforcement learning and language model scaling, questioning the role of learning history.

items.title: Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design
items.summary: Mirror-Score introduces a new inference-only scoring method to evaluate computational D-peptide designs, exposing limitations in existing sequence-compatibility ranking.

items.title: The Layer Mystery of VLA: An Information-Theoretical Analysis of VLA Latent Interface
items.summary: This research provides an information-theoretical analysis of the 'latent interface' in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, investigating optimal layer selection for action generation.

items.title: AdaST: Adaptive Coupling for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting
items.summary: AdaST proposes an adaptive coupling method for spatial-temporal forecasting, addressing the varying coupling regimes observed in real-world data from systems like traffic and energy networks.

items.title: Principled Thoughts for Latent Recursive LLM Systems
items.summary: This theoretical paper explores fundamental principles for 'latent recursive LLM systems,' discussing how large language models can reason in continuous space using hidden states, potentially involving agents.

items.title: ChronoSRL: Temporal Geometry for Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This paper introduces ChronoSRL, a self-supervised reinforcement learning method that measures distances in representation space in units of time to improve goal-reaching in complex environments.

items.title: CoRe: Co-Evolving Reward Models for Mitigating Latent Reward Hacking in Video Diffusion Models
items.summary: This research introduces CoRe, a method using co-evolving reward models to mitigate latent reward hacking, a problem where video diffusion models optimize for high rewards without improving perceptual or motion quality.

items.title: From Surfaces to Volumes: Registered Geometry for Protein Representation Learning
items.summary: This research explores representing protein geometry using registered volumetric organization rather than just surface features to improve protein representation learning.

items.title: Illusory Truth or Mere Exposure? Model-Dependent Repetition Effects in LLM-Based Social Media Simulations
items.summary: This study uses generative agent-based models to simulate social media dynamics and investigate how repetition effects and cognitive biases like the Illusory Truth Effect manifest in LLM agents.

items.title: Towards an AI Software Factory for Data Systems
items.summary: This paper outlines progress towards an 'AI Software Factory' designed to accelerate all stages of the software development lifecycle for data systems using AI-assisted coding tools.

items.title: HyperZip: Efficient Data Compression through Personalized Diffusion LLMs with Hypernetworks
items.summary: HyperZip proposes an efficient LLM-based compression framework that leverages personalized diffusion LLMs with hypernetworks for lossless data compression, addressing computational costs and throughput.

items.title: From Retrieval to Reasoning: Agentic Mechanism Prediction from Cell Painting Profiles
items.summary: This research explores using an agentic approach for mechanism prediction from Cell Painting profiles to advance biological inference, moving beyond simple representation matching.

items.title: Bits Under ZK-LLM: Evaluating Zero-Knowledge-Friendly Quantization for Verifiable Private LLM Inference
items.summary: This research evaluates zero-knowledge-friendly quantization techniques to enable private and verifiable inference for large language models, allowing for auditing while protecting proprietary model parameters.

items.title: Rethinking Reasoning Paths as Phase-Structured Trajectories
items.summary: This paper proposes a method to analyze hidden states within large language models' multi-step reasoning paths, treating them as phase-structured trajectories to improve problem-solving.

items.title: Human-AI Collaboration: From Paradoxes to Patterns
items.summary: This paper examines human-AI collaboration by studying two design dimensions, autonomy and initiative, to identify patterns that lead to better joint performance.

items.title: Visual sensitivity is not claim retractability: persistence-aware credit assignment for multimodal reinforcement learning
items.summary: This paper investigates credit assignment for multimodal reinforcement learning with Large Vision-Language Models, arguing for persistence-aware methods over simple visual sensitivity.

items.title: Sage: Formalization with Semantic Correction
items.summary: Sage is a system for formalizing natural language into formal mathematical statements using neural theorem provers, addressing the challenge of semantic correction and data bottlenecks.

items.title: Serverless gossip training of LSTM failure detectors: A matched-protocol comparison with federated, local and centralized learning on NASA C-MAPSS
items.summary: This study compares serverless gossip training for LSTM failure detectors against federated, local, and centralized learning on NASA C-MAPSS data for industrial predictive maintenance.

items.title: Learning from the Gap Between Pass@K and Pass@1
items.summary: This paper investigates learning from the performance gap between Pass@K and Pass@1 in large language models trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, analyzing strategies for test-time scaling.

items.title: Calibration-First Cross-Cohort Multimodal Temporal Learning for Transferable Asthma-Risk Forecasting
items.summary: CALIBRA is a novel approach for transferable asthma-risk forecasting using multimodal temporal learning that prioritizes calibration across changing patient populations and sensor ecosystems.

items.title: Binarization Flattens the Score Space
items.summary: This research explores how binarizing rewards from large language model judges impacts the score space, affecting how well a response's criteria are captured.

items.title: HeadGuard: Selective Head Protection for Low-Bit VLM KV-Cache Quantization
items.summary: HeadGuard is a new composable method that uses selective head protection to mitigate degradation in vision-language model accuracy caused by low-bit KV-cache quantization.

items.title: Learned Compression of SAR Phase-History Data: A Rate-Honest Feasibility Study on GOTCHA
items.summary: This study evaluates the feasibility of using a learned convolutional autoencoder for on-board compression of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) phase-history data, comparing it to block-adaptive quantization.

items.title: A Mesoscopic View of Transformer Weights Through Row and Column Scale Fields
items.summary: This paper offers a mesoscopic view of Transformer weights by analyzing row and column scale fields, providing insights into magnitude distribution across functional channels.

items.title: Position: Let's Strengthen Verifiability If We Can't Enforce Reproducibility
items.summary: This position paper argues for strengthening the verifiability of results in machine learning research, given the increasing difficulty in enforcing reproducibility.

items.title: Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles
items.summary: This research adapts Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically classify economic policy uncertainty in news articles for public sector monitoring, moving beyond traditional keyword-based methods.

items.title: ReLOBGen: Replayable Limit Order Book Message Generation
items.summary: This paper introduces ReLOBGen, a method for generating replayable limit order book (LOB) messages essential for closed-loop market simulation. It addresses the issue of non-replayable messages produced by existing generators.

items.title: Hybrid Ensemble Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Forecasting
items.summary: This research proposes a calibrated hybrid ensemble learning method that combines five deep learning models for patient-independent EEG-based epileptic seizure forecasting. It aims to improve generalization and false-alarm control.

items.title: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This paper argues for supplementing offline reinforcement learning with adaptive priors, moving beyond static policies, to enhance robustness and address uncertainty outside the offline dataset.

items.title: Learning in the Transverse Subspace: A Minimal Representation for Divergence-Free Operator Learning
items.summary: This paper introduces a minimal representation method for learning divergence-free operators by performing learning in the transverse subspace. This approach reduces redundancy in parameterizations for systems like incompressible flows and PDE systems.

items.title: The Decision Value of Perception Compute
items.summary: This paper defines the 'decision value of perception compute' as the change in downstream loss resulting from improved perception output within an adaptive perception system. It analyzes how perception computation affects downstream decision systems.

items.title: Replication Failure and Trivial Baselines in Road-Level Crash Prediction
items.summary: This study investigates the stability of gains reported by graph neural networks for road-level crash prediction, finding replication failures and issues with trivial baselines in a recent uncertainty-aware model.

items.title: Graph neural networks for sampling-invariant embeddings of organized signal sets
items.summary: This paper investigates the use of graph neural networks to generate sampling-invariant embeddings for organized signal sets, such as those from sensor networks and radars, where individual signals may have distinct sampling parameters.

items.title: KernelOnet: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Kernel Functions
items.summary: This paper introduces KernelOnet, an interpretable neural operator framework that integrates kernel functions into its architecture to align with kernel-expansion methods. It offers a new approach to neural operators.

items.title: EnJoi: Ensemble Joint Score Filter for Generative Data Assimilation
items.summary: This paper proposes EnJoi, an Ensemble Joint Score Filter, for generative data assimilation, which utilizes score-based models to generate physically consistent trajectories that align with observations.

items.title: FluxLite: Inference-Time Proposal Control for Discrete Diffusion Models
items.summary: This paper introduces FluxLite, a method for inference-time proposal control in discrete diffusion models, addressing challenges with Feynman-Kac sequential Monte Carlo by improving weight stability.

items.title: ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision
items.summary: This paper proposes ROSS, a method for relearning from self-generated rollouts through selective supervision during large language model post-training with reinforcement learning. It aims to preserve useful behaviors from historical data.

items.title: Making Cross-Continental Federated Learning Repeatable with FLIP: a Multi-Application Study
items.summary: This paper introduces FLIP (Federated Learning Interoperability Platform), an open-source, multi-application platform designed to make cross-continental federated learning repeatable, particularly addressing governance challenges in healthcare collaborations.

items.title: Neural networks for spectral optimization
items.summary: This paper proposes two neural network models for efficiently solving spectral optimization problems, aiming to find a domain that optimizes a functional dependent on a differential operator's spectrum.

items.title: Improving scalable oversight with co-trained monitors
items.summary: This research explores co-training monitors alongside workers in AI oversight setups to prevent monitor evasion. It investigates both supervised and self-supervised approaches to improve scalable AI oversight.

items.title: ABC: Advantage-Based Control Variates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
items.summary: This paper introduces ABC (Advantage-Based Control Variates), a new technique for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. It aims to improve critic-free policy-gradient methods and address approximation error in actor-critic methods.

items.title: Understanding Decision-Making Mechanisms in Neural Routing Solvers
items.summary: This paper investigates the internal decision-making mechanisms of neural routing solvers in Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO), examining how autoregressive models like AM and POMO arrive at their decisions.

items.title: GEM-KMeans: Memory-Efficient and Accurate Clustering on Massive Scale with GPU Optimization
items.summary: This paper introduces GEM-KMeans, a memory-efficient and accurate clustering method for massive-scale data, which utilizes GPU optimization and non-negative low-rank matrix factorization for K-means.

items.title: Early Learning Shapes Later Directions Of Representation Change In Continual Learning
items.summary: This research investigates how early representational changes in neural networks form a geometric structure that influences later learning in continual learning tasks. It identifies a low-dimensional subspace of early representation drift, termed a scaffold, that shapes subsequent learning.

items.title: PHASE: A Physiology-Guided Hierarchical Foundation Model for Intracranial EEG
items.summary: PHASE is a physiology-guided hierarchical foundation model designed for analyzing intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) data. It learns by reconstructing or predicting input based on directly measurable physiological characteristics, aiding clinicians and neuroscientists.

items.title: Data Unlearning via Inverse Distillation
items.summary: This paper introduces Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU), a unified framework designed to enable multi-step matching models, such as flow and diffusion models, to unlearn unwanted components from their training datasets. IDU also aims to simultaneously distill these models to reduce inference costs.

items.title: LoopICL: Looping a single transformer block to solve tabular tasks
items.summary: LoopICL is a new looped transformer architecture designed to efficiently solve tabular tasks using in-context learning. Its core design decouples parameters, aiming to address redundancy observed in current tabular foundation models.

items.title: Koa-action: Fast and Consistent Structured Decision Making with Generative LLMs
items.summary: Koa-action is a method aimed at enabling fast and consistent structured decision-making using generative large language models (LLMs). It addresses the challenge of low-latency classification in industry applications where current LLM approaches are often too slow.

items.title: ThinQuant: Scalable Rotation Learning for Weight and Activation Quantization of LLMs
items.summary: ThinQuant is a method for scalable rotation learning used in the weight and activation quantization of large language models (LLMs). It aims to enable low-bit quantization by smoothing outliers in the activation distribution, improving efficiency.

items.title: Reasoning with Neural Cellular Automata
items.summary: This work investigates the reasoning capabilities of Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) for visual reasoning tasks, proposing them as a decentralized alternative to traditional AI architectures that rely on global connectivity.

items.title: Draft in Parallel, Condition Through Depth: Adjacent Causal Injection for Speculative Decoding
items.summary: This paper introduces "Adjacent Causal Injection for Speculative Decoding," a method designed to improve parallel speculative drafting in LLMs by addressing inconsistent continuations that can shorten accepted prefixes. It aims to enhance the speed and quality of text generation.

items.title: Fair Policy Optimization in Major-Minor Weakly Coupled Markov Decision Processes
items.summary: This research focuses on fair policy optimization within major-minor weakly coupled Markov decision processes (M2WCMDPs) for sequential decision-making environments. It addresses resource allocation fairness by considering coupled action spaces under resource constraints.

items.title: EvoMO-SR: Multiobjective LLM-based Evolution of Symbolic Expressions with substructure guidance
items.summary: EvoMO-SR is a multiobjective, Large Language Model-based method for Symbolic Regression (SR), designed for scientific discovery. It utilizes LLMs with substructure guidance to search for interpretable analytical relationships within data.

items.title: Physical Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoding for Seismic-to-Well Representation Learning
items.summary: This paper proposes "Physical Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoding" for seismic-to-well representation learning, aiming to align diverse modalities in scientific measurements. It addresses the dense-sparse problem in subsurface characterization using 3D seismic and well log data.

items.title: Representable but Unlearned: Encoding Rank and the Interaction-Prediction Floor
items.summary: This research investigates how input encodings can limit the measured contrasts a predictor can jointly reproduce, even when no single contrast is forced to vanish. It computes the attainable contrast space from an encoder's equivalence classes and a fixed contrast design.

items.title: On the spectral properties of generative denoiser Jacobians
items.summary: This paper examines the spectral properties of generative denoiser Jacobians in models like diffusion and flow-matching, which learn to sample from complex distributions. It provides a deeper analytical understanding of these generative denoising models.

items.title: EnergyEminence: Source-Aware Environmental Calibration and Evaluation in a Physics-Grounded Grid Digital Twin
items.summary: EnergyEminence is an early-stage testbed for a physics-grounded digital twin of power grids, designed for source-aware environmental calibration and evaluation. It combines data-driven prediction with physically meaningful state evolution for an IEEE 118-bus-style grid.

items.title: Preconditioned Physics-Informed Neural Operator Training
items.summary: This paper introduces "Preconditioned Physics-Informed Neural Operator Training," a method to train neural operators purely from governing physics equations. This approach eliminates the need for large offline datasets typically generated by classical solvers.

items.title: How Language Models Differ in Redistributing Attention-Head Activity Under Serial Demand
items.summary: This research investigates how language models redistribute activity across their attention heads in response to varying serial task demands. It offers insight into how these models route information through their depth, contributing to a mechanistic understanding.

items.title: BASE: Batch-Aware Selection of Experts Using Predicted Removal Error for Efficient MoE Decoding
items.summary: BASE (Batch-Aware Selection of Experts) is a method for efficient decoding in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models. It aims to reduce the computational cost of serving LLMs by optimizing the selection of experts and mitigating bottlenecks in autoregressive decoding.

items.title: The Role of Feed-Forward Layers in Transformer Dynamics
items.summary: This research studies the dynamical behavior of tokens within transformers from a control-theoretic perspective, specifically focusing on the role of feed-forward layers. It interprets the self-attention mechanism as an interacting particle system.

items.title: Can Representation Learning Decouple from Loss Minimization? Polar Updates Have an Answer
items.summary: Investigates whether representation learning can decouple from loss minimization, focusing on matrix Muon and its polar-normalized updates. The study explores the behavior of this algorithm near the edge of stability in teacher-student problems.

items.title: Reliable but Design-Sensitive: Instrument Uncertainty in LLM Annotation
items.summary: This study investigates the instrument uncertainty in LLM annotation, showing that LLMs can yield inconsistent labels for tasks like offensive language detection depending on experimental design choices.

items.title: When Should LLMs Trust Their Own Revisions? A Risk-Aware Study of Intrinsic Self-Correction
items.summary: This risk-aware study investigates the trade-offs of intrinsic self-correction in 29 open-weight LLMs, analyzing when models should trust their own revisions without external evidence.

items.title: The Detectability Gap: Hidden Heterogeneity in Hallucination Detection Across Language Models
items.summary: This work investigates the "detectability gap" and hidden heterogeneity in hallucination detection across four language models using factual question answering datasets, showing systematic differences in detectable errors.

items.title: Resolving the Missing Financial Data Crisis: A Generative AI Pipeline for SEC 10-K Extraction
items.summary: This research introduces a generative AI pipeline designed to extract crucial financial information from SEC 10-K filings, aiming to resolve a significant missing-data problem in financial datasets.

items.title: Question-Specific Knowledge Graphs for Efficient Visual Reasoning
items.summary: This research proposes using question-specific knowledge graphs to enhance visual reasoning capabilities in vision-language models by improving the retention and alignment of visual details.

items.title: Causal and Interpretable Structures in LLM Compositional Tasks
items.summary: This study explores the causal and interpretable structures within large language models, investigating how relational information for compositional tasks is represented and processed across transformer layers.

items.title: A Character-Level Neural Approach to Sinhala Sandhi Splitting
items.summary: This research proposes a character-level neural approach for Sinhala Sandhi splitting, a crucial task for Sinhala natural language processing to recover constituent words from phonologically merged forms.

items.title: Language Models Are "Insecure" Reporters
items.summary: This research highlights that language models can be "insecure reporters" when deployed in autonomous long-horizon tasks, making it difficult for users to rely on their generated reports for auditing and verification.

items.title: Concept Direction Reliability Across Languages with Different Tokenizer Fertility
items.summary: This research evaluates the concept direction reliability across different languages and tokenizer fertility, measuring sentiment direction reproducibility in four language models using English, Hausa, and Yoruba.

items.title: The Canonical Order Problem: When Large Language Models Are Unreliable Knowledge Bases for Multi-Valued Relations
items.summary: This paper investigates the reliability of large language models (LLMs) as knowledge bases for extracting multi-valued relations, highlighting challenges in their use beyond single relational triples.

items.title: Lost in Translation: Measuring the Effect of Non-Native English on End User Performance of Large Language Models
items.summary: This study measures the impact of non-native English on the performance and response quality of large language models, aiming to identify specific linguistic features that cause lower quality for non-fluent speakers.

items.title: Cognitive Expert Language Models Better Align with the Corresponding Brain Systems
items.summary: This research explores how 'cognitive expert language models' better align with corresponding human brain systems during natural language comprehension compared to single-model approaches.

items.title: Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States
items.summary: This paper presents OLIVE (OnLine InterVEntion), a method where a student policy learns by iteratively generating prefixes and being updated based on autoregressive continuations from a teacher.

items.title: Reliable Parallel Decoding in Masked Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: This study investigates the reliability of parallel decoding in Masked Diffusion Language Models, analyzing when multiple token predictions can be committed together effectively for text generation.

items.title: Similar Choices, Different Attention: Cross-Modal Associations in Humans and Vision-Language Models
items.summary: This paper compares how humans and Vision-Language Models process cross-modal associations, such as linking sounds to shapes, to understand their respective attention mechanisms.

items.title: When Updating Stops Being Learning: Rethinking LLM Self-Evolution via learnable information gain
items.summary: This paper rethinks the self-evolution process of large language models, proposing a method based on learnable information gain to address and prevent self-evolution degeneration.

items.title: DraftTrace: A Multi-View Analytics Environment for AI-Integrated Writing
items.summary: DraftTrace is introduced as a multi-view analytics environment designed to capture and analyze the full writing process when generative AI is integrated into student assignments.

items.title: One Geometry, Different Outcomes: Readout-Dependent Effects of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models
items.summary: This research investigates the 'modality gap' in contrastive vision-language models, analyzing how it affects shared embedding spaces and representation performance in tasks like zero-shot classification.

items.title: From Sharp Eyes to Expert Mind: Internalizing Expert Knowledge in MLLMs for Tampered Text Detection
items.summary: This research explores methods for internalizing expert knowledge into Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to improve their performance and generalization in tampered text detection.

items.title: Boosting Metric Depth Completion via Training-Free Adaptive Response Geometry
items.summary: This paper introduces a training-free adaptive response geometry method to boost metric depth completion by better aligning visual foundation models used as geometric priors to true metric scale.

items.title: Exploring Learning Models for Topological Relationship Recognition from Image Data
items.summary: This research explores various learning models designed for topological relationship recognition from image data, focusing on how objects relate spatially in fields like GIS and biomedical imaging.

items.title: FD-AA: A Lightweight Focal-Diffuse And Attenuation-Aware Head for Incidental Abdominal Abnormality Detection in Chest CT
items.summary: FD-AA is proposed as a lightweight, organ-aware classification head designed for detecting incidental abdominal abnormalities in chest CT scans by extracting features from varying organ structures.

items.title: Sparse-View Interpretable 3D Animal Behavior Representations for Neural Encoding and Decoding
items.summary: This research focuses on developing sparse-view, interpretable 3D animal behavior representations from video, intended for scientific analysis and understanding neural encoding and decoding of brain function.

items.title: LeRF: Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking Reasoning
items.summary: LeRF is a method for learning reference coordinate frames to enhance perspective-taking reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), addressing a fundamental challenge in spatial intelligence.

items.title: Representation by Design in Generation: Cross-View Class-Token Alignment in Diffusion Transformers
items.summary: This research explores 'Representation by Design in Generation,' investigating how Diffusion Transformers can be trained to learn substantial semantic representations directly through cross-view class-token alignment.

items.title: OTT3R: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Fast Dataset Generation at 1% Compute
items.summary: OTT3R is a novel system for multi-view 3D reconstruction and fast dataset generation, significantly reducing computational requirements by achieving performance at just 1% of the typical compute cost.

items.title: Stealth Is a Relation, Not a Property: How Event Representations Create Blind Spots for Timing Attacks in Event-Based Perception
items.summary: This research investigates how event representations in event-based perception can create vulnerabilities for timing attacks, depending on how models process temporal data from event cameras.

items.title: Towards Scalable Context-Aware Single-Cell Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology Images
items.summary: This research explores a method for scalable, context-aware prediction of single-cell spatial transcriptomics from histology images, aiming to overcome limitations of existing spot-level approaches.

items.title: Temporal-Aware Fusion for Robust Outdoor LiDAR Localization
items.summary: This paper introduces a temporal-aware fusion technique to improve the robustness of outdoor LiDAR relocalization, addressing limitations of single-frame inference in dynamic environments.

items.title: RA-CFGCache: From Branch-Level Criteria to Guided-Risk Control under Classifier-Free Guidance
items.summary: This research presents RA-CFGCache, a training-free caching method to reduce the computational cost of iterative denoising in diffusion models, especially under classifier-free guidance.

items.title: DARE to Mitigate Hallucination: Dual-path Auto-Regressive-aware Editing
items.summary: This research introduces DARE, a dual-path auto-regressive-aware editing method designed to mitigate object hallucination in large vision-language models without additional training.

items.title: DynamicHOI: Coupled Dynamics for Physics-aware HOI Reconstruction
items.summary: This paper studies DynamicHOI, a method for physics-aware hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction from monocular RGB videos, focusing on achieving mechanically consistent trajectories.

items.title: How Medical VLMs Underutilize Their Vision Encoders: A Dermatology Perspective

items.title: FM-ReID: Selective Competitive Token Routing for Object Re-Identification

items.title: AffectReveal: Event-Grounded Emotion Recognition Beyond Visual Appearances
items.summary: This research proposes AffectReveal, an event-grounded emotion recognition framework that considers contextual events beyond visual appearances to more accurately interpret emotions.

items.summary: This research constructs VIGOR-his, a decade-spanning cross-view dataset, and a reward-guided editing method for generating historical street-view imagery by restoring changes while preserving scene content.

items.summary: This paper proposes OCA (ODE-Driven Cross-Attention), a new method to improve image-to-point-cloud registration by mitigating attention ambiguity in learning-based mechanisms.

items.title: FocusVTC: Efficient and High-Performance Visual Text Compression with Adaptive Resolution
items.summary: This paper introduces FocusVTC, an efficient visual text compression method with adaptive resolution designed to reduce computation and memory costs for long-context reasoning in large language models.

items.title: You Only Reprogram Once: Rethinking Prolonged Training for Visual Reprogramming
items.summary: This paper presents a method for visual reprogramming to adapt pretrained models more efficiently, addressing the computational expense of prolonged training for visual prompts.

items.title: Reprogramming Vision-Language Models via Structured Prompt Reparameterization

items.title: {\Delta}WAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models
items.summary: This research introduces $\Delta$WAM, a method for distilling action tangent fields into World Action Models (WAMs), aiming to improve robot policies by augmenting sparse action supervision with dense future prediction.

items.title: On-Demand Robotic Assembly via Differentiable Geometric Part Repair
items.summary: This paper introduces an autonomous pipeline for the design and physical construction of bespoke wooden assemblies, aiming to streamline the transition from digital design to robotic assembly.

items.title: Enhancing Robotic Perception and Adaptability through Sensor Fusion and Origami-Inspired Designs
items.summary: This research presents a compact mobile robot featuring origami-inspired wheels for locomotion and active control of its sensing geometry, enhancing perception and adaptability in varying environmental conditions.

items.title: Towards Accurate End-Effector Localization for UMI-Style Robotic Manipulation Teaching
items.summary: This research focuses on achieving accurate end-effector localization for robotic manipulation teaching, addressing challenges like camera occlusion in close-range robot demonstration learning.

items.title: UBTECH and FAW-Volkswagen Take Humanoid Robots From Quality Inspection Into Factory Logistics
items.summary: UBTECH and FAW-Volkswagen are collaborating to develop and test humanoid robots for factory logistics, expanding on the use of Walker S Lite for quality inspection.

items.title: AI firm HUMXN offers free plumbing and HVAC service in Minnesota to train robots
items.summary: AI firm HUMXN is offering free plumbing and HVAC services in Minnesota as a program to train its robots in real-world environments.

items.title: Generalizable Robustness Testing of DNN-Based Robotic Navigation Systems via XAI-Guided Search
items.summary: This paper presents a method for generalizable robustness testing of Deep Neural Network (DNN)-based robotic navigation systems using XAI-guided search, aiming to identify unsafe behaviors under input perturbations.

items.title: RMRRT: Riemannian Barrier Metric RRT for Inequality-Aware Steering on Equality Manifolds
items.summary: RMRRT introduces a Riemannian barrier metric RRT motion planning framework that unifies equality and inequality constraints for steering in high-dimensional robotic systems, improving geometric formulation for sampling-based planners.

items.title: Geometric Coherence via Weighted Matching for 3D Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reach-Avoid Games
items.summary: This research studies assignment quality in 3D heterogeneous multi-agent reach-avoid games, identifying 'Geometric Sprawl' as a failure mode of cardinality-only matching in structured scenarios.

items.title: Does a Learned Corrector Beat a Simple Retreat? Evidence from a Frozen VLA
items.summary: This study evaluates the effectiveness of a learned corrector for runtime recovery of a frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy in robot manipulation tasks within the Robosuite environment.

items.title: SWAP: Stepwise Action Policy Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: SWAP proposes a framework for stepwise action policy routing that dynamically composes multiple Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies during execution for robust robot manipulation systems.

items.title: ROMA: LLM System for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception
items.summary: ROMA introduces an LLM system for real-world object-centric multi-sensory active perception, enabling AI systems to interact with the physical environment by actively acquiring and interpreting sensory information.

items.title: Learning Modular Policy for Multi-Floor Object Navigation:A Factorized Framework for Diagnostic Study
items.summary: This paper proposes a factorized framework with a learnable policy for object-goal navigation in multi-floor scenarios, addressing challenges posed by sparse rewards in long-horizon decision-making for robots.

items.title: ACG-WAM: World-Action Modeling via Action-Conditioned Geometric Latent Prediction
items.summary: ACG-WAM introduces a method for world-action modeling that jointly learns visual prediction and robot actions, providing explicit targets for the geometric consequences of demonstrated action sequences to improve policy learning.

items.title: ProactiveVLA: Augmenting Embodied Memory through Proactive Environment Exploration
items.summary: ProactiveVLA enhances robot adaptation to new environments by augmenting embodied memory through proactive exploration, allowing a reasoning agent combined with a vision-language-action model (VLA) to acquire useful knowledge.

items.title: LEAP: Making Privileged Geometry Supervision Effective for Visuomotor Learning
items.summary: LEAP explores how privileged 3D geometric supervision can effectively guide RGB-based visuomotor policy learning for robots during training, ensuring visual representations capture geometry useful for control without requiring geometric inputs at deployment.

items.title: BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking
items.summary: BRACE addresses the challenge of whole-body motion tracking for humanoid robots by adapting reference motions to account for forces the robot exchanges with objects and the terrain it stands on, moving beyond level-ground assumptions.

items.title: Demo: Vision-Language Model-Guided Online Calibration of an Electromagnetic Digital Twin
items.summary: This demonstration showcases a vision-language model (VLM)-guided framework for online calibration of an electromagnetic digital twin, which enhances mobile robots' wireless situational awareness by adapting to changing material conductivities.

items.title: TeleHairing: A Teleoperation Baseline for Robotic Haircutting
items.summary: TeleHairing presents a teleoperation baseline for robotic haircutting, focusing on controlled tool motion near the head and accounting for communication, visual feedback, and actuation, providing a reference for analyzing coupled behaviors.

items.title: AIM: Adaptive Interaction Modeling Networks for Real-to-Sim Soft-Body Simulation
items.summary: AIM proposes Adaptive Interaction Modeling Networks for real-to-sim soft-body simulation to support robotic manipulation tasks involving deformable objects, enabling robots to control shape changes and object motion.

items.title: What the Elevation Map Cannot See: Semantic-Aware Locomotion and Execution-Aware Navigation for Humanoid Robot
items.summary: This paper explores semantic-aware locomotion and execution-aware navigation for humanoid robots, addressing limitations of elevation maps in identifying hazards and improving navigation capabilities in complex environments.

items.title: RACER: Residual-Adaptive Closed-Loop Estimation for Sampling-Based Planning in Wheeled-Quadruped Racing
items.summary: RACER is presented as a hierarchical control framework for wheeled-quadruped racing, combining an MPPI planner with a learned residual dynamics model and an RL velocity tracker to enhance performance and capture closed-loop dynamics.

items.title: MobileVISTA: Generative Data Augmentation for Pose Generalization in Mobile Manipulation
items.summary: MobileVISTA proposes generative data augmentation to improve pose generalization in mobile manipulation tasks for robots, including humanoids, enabling them to perform dexterous tasks in dynamic environments despite limited demonstration data.

items.title: ProCut: Probabilistic Cutting Topology for Autonomous Electrosurgical Tissue Dissection
items.summary: ProCut introduces a probabilistic cutting topology approach for autonomous electrosurgical tissue dissection, aiming to accurately model and track the deformation of soft tissue during surgical procedures involving topological changes.

items.title: Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Researchers introduce TIGER, a reward-construction and pretraining framework for efficient reinforcement learning in sparse-reward tabletop robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: Seeing the Invisible: Physics-Guided Visual Prompting for Temperature- and Radiation-Aware VLA Navigation
items.summary: This paper explores physics-guided visual prompting for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to enable navigation in safety-critical environments with invisible risks like radiation or temperature spikes.

items.title: OpenSplatGraph: From Dense Semantic Maps to Structured Scene Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Robot Perception
items.summary: OpenSplatGraph is presented as a method to convert dense semantic maps into structured scene graphs for improved open-vocabulary robotic perception in complex environments.

items.title: Learning Grasp Targeting from Point Clouds for Log Pile Clearing on a Hydraulic Crane
items.summary: This research details a learned policy for grasp targeting from point clouds, enabling a hydraulic crane to efficiently clear dense log piles in mill yards.

items.title: TacZero: Training-Free Peg Insertion Using a General-Purpose Vision-Language Model with Tactile Feedback
items.summary: TacZero enables training-free peg insertion by utilizing a general-purpose vision-language model with tactile feedback, allowing robots to autonomously perform contact-rich manipulation tasks.

items.title: SMART: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Articulated Object Manipulation via Large-Scale Synthetic Pretraining
items.summary: SMART is a method for zero-shot sim-to-real articulated object manipulation achieved through large-scale synthetic pretraining, addressing challenges in real-world data collection for embodied intelligent systems.

items.title: EigenDEXplore: Structured Exploration for Dexterous Manipulation with Human Priors
items.summary: EigenDEXplore proposes a structured exploration method incorporating human priors to tackle the high-dimensional optimization problem of dexterous manipulation in robotics.

items.title: CoRE: Learning Collaboration-Role Experts for Decentralized Collaborative Manipulation with One Policy
items.summary: CoRE (Collaboration-Role Experts) focuses on learning a single policy for decentralized collaborative manipulation, allowing multiple robots to perform complementary actions based on their individual observations.

items.title: Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization for Constrained Locomotion Planning
items.summary: This research presents a model-based geometry-aware generative optimization technique for constrained locomotion planning in quadrupeds and humanoids, addressing complex dynamics and environmental constraints.

items.title: Chinese Humanoid Robots Appear at South Korea's Parliamentary Audit… Physical AI Investment 'Woefully Inadequate' - BigGo Finance
items.summary: Chinese humanoid robots were showcased at a South Korean parliamentary audit, prompting concerns that physical AI investment in the country is insufficient.

items.title: Transfar Opens 300+ Industrial Scenarios to Embodied AI, From Chemical Plants to Logistics Parks
items.summary: Transfar is opening over 300 industrial sites as test grounds for training and deploying AI-powered physical robots and embodied AI systems.

items.title: Building a Streaming Robotics Learning Pipeline Using NVIDIA Cosmos3-DROID
items.summary: This article demonstrates how to build an end-to-end streaming learning pipeline for robotics using the NVIDIA Cosmos3-DROID dataset, leveraging techniques like behavior cloning and temporal ensembling.

items.title: A Tesla Veteran Is Running a Copper Mine with AI-Powered Robots
items.summary: A former Tesla executive is utilizing AI-powered robots to operate a copper mine in an industrial application.

items.title: Humanoid robot brings STEM lessons to life at Moose Jaw day camp - moosejawtoday.com
items.summary: A humanoid robot is being used to teach STEM lessons at a day camp in Moose Jaw.

items.title: The Humanoid Robot Future Has Arrived at a South Korean Park. Sort of.
items.summary: A South Korean park, Galaxy Robot Park in Seoul, is showcasing humanoid robots, offering a glimpse into a potential future with these machines.

items.title: The Humanoid Robot Future Has Arrived at a South Korean Park. Sort of. - The New York Times
items.summary: A South Korean park, Galaxy Robot Park in Seoul, is showcasing humanoid robots, offering a glimpse into a potential future with these machines.

items.title: Research could guide the future design of social robots
items.summary: New research from the University of Glasgow suggests that giving social robots animal-like or anime-style faces and voices could enhance their emotional appeal and guide future design in the field.

items.title: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
items.summary: This paper introduces progressive visual planning for world action models (WAMs) to improve long-horizon prediction in robotic control. It addresses challenges in generating dense video rollouts for predicting future visual dynamics and actions.

items.title: SoTa: Soft Tactile Skins for Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: This research introduces 'SoTa,' soft tactile skins designed to enhance robot policies with contact information, complementing vision for dexterous manipulation tasks and addressing the scarcity of visuo-tactile robot data.

items.title: Filter-Aware Fine-Tuning for Safe Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking
items.summary: This paper proposes a filter-aware fine-tuning method to ensure safe whole-body motion for humanoid robots, crucial for their deployment in unstructured environments, by optimizing reinforcement-learning policies to track references effectively.

items.title: SocialVLA: A Social Perception Gateway for Human-Reaction-Based Failure Detection and Recovery in VLA Manipulation
items.summary: This research introduces SocialVLA, a system that uses human social reactions (vocal, facial, verbal) as a gateway for failure detection and recovery in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robotic manipulation policies, enabling robots to recognize and correct errors.

items.title: Rethinking World-Action Model for Compositional and In-Context Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: This paper proposes rethinking World-Action Models (WAMs) to better handle long-horizon compositional robotic manipulation by integrating explicit subtask-level representations into their joint prediction of visual futures and actions.

items.title: Keep the Effect, Drop the Actor: Programmable Effect-to-Execution World-Action Models
items.summary: This research introduces Programmable Effect-to-Execution World-Action Models that learn from robot demonstrations by focusing on the effect on objects (3D keypoint trajectories) rather than specific arm actions, compiling demonstrations into an effect program.

items.title: Autonomous mobile robot operations logistics: a dataset of jobs, dispatch events and robot states
items.summary: This paper presents MoRoOp, a dataset of autonomous mobile robot (AMR) operations in a laboratory kit preparation and supply scenario, detailing job generation, dispatch events, and robot states for production logistics applications.

items.title: RUL-Aware RRT*: Degradation-Balanced Motion Planning for Robotic Manipulators
items.summary: This research proposes RUL-Aware RRT*, a degradation-balanced motion planning algorithm for robotic manipulators that considers uneven joint degradation to prevent premature actuator failure and reduce operational losses during long-duration operations.

items.title: CriticHack: Evaluating Visual Rewards Under Robot Policy Optimization
items.summary: CriticHack is a method for evaluating visual reward models used in robot policy optimization, demonstrating that these models can score incorrect actions highly and that optimizing such rewards can amplify wrong-object failures.

items.title: A Passive AI System for Verifying Physical State on Automated Liquid Handlers
items.summary: This paper introduces the Labware Setup Checker, a passive vision AI system designed to verify the physical setup and deck preparation on automated liquid handlers like the Opentrons Flex, ensuring that the physical arrangement matches digital protocols.

items.title: DeltaWorld: Physically Consistent Interactive World Simulators via Action-Conditioned Latent Increment Learning
items.summary: DeltaWorld proposes interactive world simulators that generate physically consistent future image sequences for robot planning, policy training, and evaluation, achieved through action-conditioned latent increment learning to predict action consequences.

items.title: GeoScaffold: Learning Compact Geometric Latents via Reconstruction for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
items.summary: GeoScaffold proposes learning compact geometric latents via reconstruction to improve the efficiency of Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) systems, enhancing 3D geometric priors for streaming Video-LLM policies that map observations and instructions to actions.

items.title: AdaTempo: Learning Shared Relative Tempo from Demonstrations for Faster Robot Manipulation
items.summary: AdaTempo is a self-supervised method that learns shared relative tempo from demonstrations, enabling visuomotor policies to achieve faster robot manipulation by optimizing the timing inherited from teleoperated demonstrations.

items.title: CSIR: Contextually and Socially Informed Robots for Efficient Person Goal Navigation
items.summary: CSIR (Contextually and Socially Informed Robots) addresses the Person Goal Navigation problem by enabling robots to efficiently search for people, incorporating contextual and social information to overcome limitations like information accessibility and language uncertainty.

items.title: Proprioceptive Sketches as Long-Horizon Intent for Generative Action Policies
items.summary: This paper proposes using proprioceptive sketches to provide long-horizon intent for generative robot policies, addressing their current limitation of predicting only short action chunks without explicit future goals, thereby improving robot motion.

items.title: SimpleTouch: Can Vision-Language-Action Models Master Contact-Rich Manipulation Without Tactile Policy Pretraining?
items.summary: SimpleTouch investigates whether Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can effectively master contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks without the need for prior tactile policy pretraining, exploring challenges in integrating tactile sensing.

items.title: LOCUS: Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs
items.summary: Presents LOCUS, a method that uses spatial graphs for robots to discriminate between containers and reason about object relationships for robust manipulation and navigation in unstructured environments.

items.title: SARI: Phase-Split Sim-Real Co-Training for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.summary: Proposes SARI (Simulated Approach, Real Interaction), a sim-real co-training framework designed to make Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models more adaptable to contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment
items.summary: Introduces FastOPD, an on-policy distillation method aimed at reducing the computational costs of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models for lightweight, real-world robotic manipulation deployment.

items.title: PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: Introduces PointWAM, a 3D world action modeling approach for dexterous robotic manipulation that learns to forecast world dynamics and predict robot actions using 3D representations.

items.title: Permutation Robustness Is Not Enough: Action Collapse in Multi-Agent Transformer Policies
items.summary: Investigates how the mismatch between unordered multi-agent teams and ordered transformer token sequences leads to 'action collapse' in multi-agent robot learning policies for cooperative navigation.

items.title: MixVLA: Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: Proposes MixVLA, a method to improve the zero-shot generalization of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation by adaptively mixing invariant and non-invariant information.

items.title: Safe Streaming Flow Planning by Aligning Sampling Dynamics with Execution Dynamics
items.summary: Addresses safe streaming flow planning for generative AI planners, focusing on aligning sampling and execution dynamics to enforce safety constraints and enable online replanning for real-world deployment of physical systems.

items.title: Beyond Reward Hacking: Proxy Divergence Across Four Layers of a Staged Humanoid Learning Pipeline
items.summary: Examines proxy divergence within a staged reinforcement learning pipeline for legged robots, analyzing how different proxies for behavior, competence, robustness, and skill contribute to humanoid learning.

items.title: Equivariant Visual-Tactile Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.summary: Proposes VISTA, an equivariant visual-tactile diffusion policy designed for data-efficient imitation learning in contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks, reducing the need for extensive expert data.

items.title: KungfuAthleteBot: learning high-dynamic humanoid motion from video with unified robust recovery
items.summary: Introduces KungfuAthleteBot, a method for enabling humanoid robots to learn and perform high-dynamic athletic motions from video data, addressing challenges of physical consistency and robust recovery.

items.title: I2CD: Direct Image-to-Convex Decomposition for Simulation-Ready Collision Geometry
items.summary: Presents I2CD, a direct image-to-convex decomposition method that efficiently converts outputs from image-to-3D generative models into simulation-ready convex collision geometry for physics simulators and motion planners.

items.title: XGenAct: Geometry-Enhanced World Action Models through Cross-Task Generation
items.summary: Introduces XGenAct, a geometry-enhanced world action model that improves robot control and manipulation by incorporating cross-task generation, enhancing spatial understanding beyond basic predictions.

items.title: Autonomous Robotic Navigation for Endovascular Brain-Computer Interface Access
items.summary: This work demonstrates autonomous robotic navigation for endovascular brain-computer interface access, involving a physical robotic system performing precise manipulation for medical procedures.

items.title: RATE: Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding for Contact-rich Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: This research introduces Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding (RATE) to improve contact-rich robotic manipulation through better tactile sensing and representation learning for physical robots.

items.title: World Action Learning via Interaction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance
items.summary: This research explores a method for learning general-purpose robot policies and robotic manipulation using interaction-centric spectral latent guidance from egocentric videos.

items.title: Bridging Frontier Reasoning and Robot Execution: From Autonomous Demonstration Generation to Dense Language Supervision
items.summary: This work explores approaches to bridge frontier AI reasoning with low-latency robot execution and manipulation, including autonomous demonstration generation and language supervision for robots.

items.title: CORNAV: Construction-Aware Reasoning for Robot Navigation on Active Worksites
items.summary: CORNAV introduces construction-aware reasoning for autonomous robot navigation on active worksites, aiming to improve efficiency and safety for physical robots in the construction industry.

items.title: How robotics and physical AI can responsibly tackle key physical security challenges
items.summary: A columnist discusses how advancements in robotics and physical AI can be responsibly leveraged to address evolving physical security challenges.

items.title: China Makes 95% of the World's Humanoid Robots, Phones Cost RMB1,000 More, and Geely and NIO Combine Battery Swap Networks - Growth Dragons
items.summary: China produces 95% of the world's humanoid robots, indicating its significant dominance in this segment of the robotics market.

items.title: Inside Omron’s next-generation LD mobile robots
items.summary: This article provides insights into Omron’s next-generation LD mobile robots, emphasizing the importance of software, safety, and fleet management. The focus is on physical robots and their capabilities.

items.title: Calling robotics startups: Submissions for the 2026 Robotics Startup Radar close soon
items.summary: A call for submissions is open for robotics startups to be included in the 2026 Robotics Startup Radar, an initiative highlighting promising new companies.

items.summary: AGIBOT has partnered with the Vietnam National Innovation Center (NIC) to advance the embodied AI industry and foster talent development.

items.summary: The article features an interview with Michelle Lu from Vsim Technology about using simulation and artificial intelligence to accelerate the learning of new skills for robots.

items.summary: Vietnam hosted its first embodied AI conference, aiming to further develop and advance the nation's robotics ecosystem. The event focused on AI systems that interact with the physical world.

items.title: China scales up embodied AI - chinadailyasia.com
items.summary: China is significantly increasing its development and application of embodied AI, indicating a national scaling up of technologies related to intelligent physical systems and robotics.

items.title: Galbot Prices ET1 Bipedal Humanoid From 79,000 Yuan, With Watch-and-Learn Skills on Upper Tiers
items.summary: Galbot is launching its ET1 bipedal humanoid robot in three versions, priced from 79,000 yuan, featuring watch-and-learn skills and targeting applications in performances and public interaction.

items.title: HumanoidTTT: Test-Time Capability Reuse for Efficient Humanoid Control
items.summary: This research introduces "HumanoidTTT," a method for efficient humanoid control through test-time capability reuse, addressing the challenge of reliably re-executing motion capabilities during continuous deployment.

items.title: Toward Humanoid Robots in Construction: A Teleoperation Feasibility Study
items.summary: This study presents a teleoperation system using extended reality (XR) and pedal-based locomotion to enable a single operator to control a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for construction tasks, addressing labor shortages.

items.title: Reactive Humanoid Multi-Contact Using Learned Stability Models
items.summary: This work presents a planning and control approach for reactive humanoid multi-contact, enabling robots to use hand contacts to stabilize themselves in low stability scenarios, preventing falls.

items.title: eRLT: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Action-Relevant Token Routing
items.summary: This paper introduces eRLT, a method for efficient reinforcement learning in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, specifically for robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: NarrativeFlow: Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Model Using Robot Velocity Fields
items.summary: NarrativeFlow proposes a flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that uses robot velocity fields for language-conditioned robotic manipulation across various robot platforms.

items.title: quARtet Marker: A 3D-Printable Multi-Tag Fiducial for Robust Near-Frontal Pose Estimation
items.summary: This paper presents the quARtet Marker, a 3D-printable fiducial designed to enhance robust pose estimation for robotic manipulation, especially when dealing with transparent or reflective objects.

items.title: WBAG: A Whole-Body and Attached-Geometry Safety Framework for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
items.summary: WBAG is a safety framework developed for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies in robotic manipulation, addressing potential collisions involving the robot, objects, and environment.

items.title: MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending
items.summary: MASkillBlender proposes a decentralized whole-body coordination approach for multi-humanoid loco-manipulation, utilizing skill blending to manage complex control and decision-making.

items.title: Recova: Agent-Guided Failure Recovery for Autonomous Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: Recova introduces an agent-guided framework for autonomous robotic manipulation that develops both task execution and failure recovery capabilities in reconstructed digital environments.

items.title: EIDA: Execution-Interface Dynamics Adaptation for Real-to-Sim-to-Real Robot Navigation
items.summary: EIDA presents a method for execution-interface dynamics adaptation to improve real-to-sim-to-real transfer for robot navigation by fitting responses from target-platform execution data.

items.title: ColoACT: Multi-Cue Action Chunking for Smooth Autonomous Colon Navigation on a Self-Propelled Endoscopic Robot
items.summary: ColoACT develops multi-cue action chunking for smooth autonomous colon navigation using a self-propelled endoscopic robot, addressing challenges like deformable anatomy and weak textures.

items.title: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
items.summary: PROMO introduces a preference-conditioned multi-objective reinforcement learning approach for quadrupedal robots to balance conflicting objectives like tracking, stability, and energy efficiency.

items.title: Ex vivo breach detection using electrical conductivity during robotic pedicle drilling in the spine
items.summary: This study explores ex vivo breach detection using electrical conductivity during robotic pedicle drilling in the spine, aiming to improve precision and reduce complications in scoliosis surgery.

items.title: Continue, Abort, or Fall: Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS) for Safe Humanoid Acrobatics
items.summary: Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS) is proposed for safe humanoid acrobatics, enabling robots to select policies (continue, abort, or fall) to prevent hardware damage during dynamic motions.

items.title: ALFRED: Requirement-driven development of an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring
items.summary: ALFRED is an open-source mobile manipulator developed for long-term plant monitoring, designed to track seasonal changes in crops and forests using ground robots with manipulation capabilities.

items.title: ReCo: Response-Consistent Locomotion with Policy-Aware MPC for Legged Manipulation
items.summary: ReCo focuses on response-consistent locomotion with policy-aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) for legged manipulation, combining learned policies with MPC to coordinate base and arm movements.

items.summary: Vishay Precision Group will showcase its custom sensing capabilities for humanoid robotics at RoboBusiness 2026, as humanoid robots move into wider deployment.

items.summary: Toborlife AI launched TURN, a U.S. reseller network, to expand the availability of Unitree robots to more businesses.

items.summary: Maven Robotics plans to mass-produce its mobile manipulator robot for industrial automation, following a recent $100 million funding round.
