items.summary: A new humanoid robot has been developed that is capable of safely working alongside human personnel. This highlights advancements in embodied AI and robotic interaction.

items.title: China’s humanoid robot surge is turning global - NAI500
items.summary: China's humanoid robot sector is experiencing rapid growth, with its influence and products expanding globally.

items.title: New Chinese embodied model Maxwell tops global AI ranking on physical tasks - South China Morning Post
items.summary: A new Chinese embodied AI model named Maxwell has achieved the top global ranking for performing physical tasks.

items.title: AdaOcc: Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction for Embodied Tasks
items.summary: This paper introduces AdaOcc, a method for adaptive 3D occupancy prediction designed to provide accurate and flexible 3D scene representations for embodied AI tasks.

items.title: Optimize, Learn, Refine: Whole-Body Grasping and Pick-and-Throw with a Spiral Soft Robot
items.summary: This research details an optimization, learning, and refinement approach for enabling a spiral soft robot to perform whole-body grasping and pick-and-throw maneuvers.

items.title: SynIL: Leveraging Synergy for Offline Imitation Learning from Imperfect Demonstration Datasets
items.summary: This research presents SynIL, a method that leverages synergy for offline imitation learning, enabling robots to acquire skills effectively even from imperfect demonstration datasets.

items.title: GestAdapt: Workspace-Conditioned Co-Speech Gesture Generation for Humanoid Robots
items.summary: This research proposes GestAdapt, a method for generating workspace-conditioned co-speech gestures, allowing humanoid robots to adapt their movements to physical environmental constraints.

items.title: Memorize, Adapt, Ignore: Diagnosing Robot Learning Mechanisms under Training Data Variation
items.summary: This paper explores robot learning mechanisms under varying training data, aiming to diagnose how robotic manipulation policies memorize, adapt, or ignore different data inputs for improved robustness.

items.title: Draft: A Parametric Tool for Robot Design Exploration
items.summary: This paper introduces Draft, a parametric tool designed to facilitate robot design exploration by integrating morphology and control iteration, improving the co-design process.

items.title: Embodiment-aware control by inference over the operator: a simulation study
items.summary: This simulation study explores embodiment-aware control in teleoperation systems by inferring operator states to enhance the sense of embodiment with the controlled device.

items.title: CADeT: Causal-Aware Deformation Transmission for Indirect Robotic Manipulation of Soft Tissue
items.summary: This paper introduces CADeT, a causal-aware deformation transmission method for indirect robotic manipulation of soft tissue, particularly in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery.

items.title: What to Attend, What to Keep: Skill-Conditioned Visuotactile Representation with Progress-Guided Event Memory
items.summary: This research investigates skill-conditioned visuotactile representation for robotic manipulation, focusing on how vision and touch guide actions like reaching and grasping, and how "event memory" influences these processes. It aims to improve multi-modal manipulation policies by addressing limitations of fixed temporal contexts.

items.title: Behavioral Persistence and Incomplete Functional Transfer of Co-evolved Communication in Evolutionary Robotics
items.summary: This work evaluates the transfer of a co-evolved communication protocol from a 2D simulation to 3D physical e-puck-type robots in a food-seeking task, without retraining their GRU network weights. It assesses the behavioral persistence and functional transfer of this communication in a physical environment.

items.title: Systematically Exploring the Capabilities of GPT-6 Astra as Embodied Policies
items.summary: This research systematically explores the capabilities of GPT-6 Astra in generating numerical robot actions as general-purpose embodied policies. It evaluates Astra's performance across six domains, examining its direct control and cooperative abilities in robotic tasks.

items.title: Dense Temporal Motion Retargeting for Legged Robots
items.summary: This work presents dense temporal motion retargeting for legged robots, enabling them to learn expressive whole-body skills from human and animal motions. It focuses on adapting complex dynamic movements, like jumps, to the specific morphology and dynamic properties of the robot.

items.title: TERRA: Terrain-Aware Reconstruction, Retargeting and Control for Musculoskeletal Locomotion
items.summary: TERRA introduces a method for terrain-aware reconstruction, retargeting, and control for musculoskeletal locomotion, enabling muscle-actuated agents to reproduce complex human motions. This research aims to overcome limitations of existing systems that are largely confined to flat ground by integrating terrain geometry.

items.title: CEER2: Directional and Tunable End-Effector and Root Compliance for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: This paper presents CEER2, a system for directional and tunable end-effector and root compliance in humanoids for loco-manipulation tasks. It addresses the challenge of physical interaction, allowing robots to respond to external forces while maintaining task-specific motion.

items.title: AIfred: Augmented Learning through Functional Robotic Embodiment at the Desk
items.summary: AIfred is a desk-based robotic system designed to provide augmented learning by integrating generative AI assistance directly into handwritten engagement. It aims to bridge the gap between digital AI guidance and physical learning activities.

items.title: PhaseSync-Exo: Human Clock Anchored Reference Adaptation for Dynamic Gait Tracking
items.summary: PhaseSync-Exo is an exoskeleton system designed for human-aware walking and dynamic gait tracking, utilizing human clock-anchored reference adaptation. It combines IMU-based reconstruction with amplitude-cadence retargeting to preserve human timing under dynamic constraints.

items.title: Coral Grow-out Robotic Assessment System (CGRAS): Scaling Coral Recruit Monitoring Through Robotics and Computer Vision
items.summary: The Coral Grow-out Robotic Assessment System (CGRAS) is proposed to scale coral recruit monitoring for reef restoration efforts. It utilizes robotics and computer vision to address the need for efficient assessment technologies in combating the impacts of climate change on coral reefs.

items.title: Locomotion-Grounded Humanoid Soccer: Task-Gated Reinforcement Learning of a Multi-Directional Kicking Library
items.summary: This research explores locomotion-grounded humanoid soccer, proposing a task-gated reinforcement learning approach for a multi-directional kicking library. It aims to improve humanoid locomotion by training it on a broader range of commands beyond simple motion tracking for ball approach.

items.title: DODGER: Safety-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation Among Dynamic Obstacles
items.summary: DODGER presents a safety-guided reinforcement learning framework for robot navigation among dynamic obstacles in human-centered environments. It uses control barrier functions (CBFs) to enable robots to avoid collisions while learning safe navigation policies.

items.title: Cue the Flow: Steering Flow-Matching Policies for Open-World Delivery Manipulation
items.summary: This research proposes a method for steering flow-matching policies to enable mobile manipulators to perform open-world goods delivery based on user instructions.

items.title: NEXUS: Perceptive Whole-Body Control for Terrain-Adaptive Teleoperation
items.summary: This paper introduces NEXUS, a perceptive whole-body control method for terrain-adaptive teleoperation, allowing a humanoid robot to mimic human behavior across different terrains.

items.title: Function beyond Form: Functional Correspondence for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
items.summary: This research addresses cross-embodiment dexterous grasp generation by introducing a functional correspondence concept for robotic hands with varying geometries and kinematics.

items.title: OccluDex: Hierarchical 3D Visuo-Tactile Representation Learning for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation under Self-Occlusion
items.summary: This paper presents OccluDex, a hierarchical 3D visuo-tactile representation learning approach for egocentric dexterous manipulation that addresses self-occlusion challenges.

items.title: Humanoid Robot Shipments Jump 432%, China Has 95% Market Share - Forbes
items.summary: Shipments of humanoid robots surged by 432%, with China holding 95% of the market share.

items.title: Solving for the hand: Startup wants to pay prosthetic users to teach robots
items.summary: Startup Psyonic plans to collect data from prosthetic hand users in developing nations to advance the development of humanoid robotic hands.

items.title: Innodata opens motion-capture lab to help humanoids move more like people
items.summary: Innodata has opened a motion-capture lab using Vicon cameras to collect sub-millimeter accurate data, helping humanoids learn to move more naturally.

items.title: Global humanoid robot shipments surge 432% in H1; China accounts for nearly 80%, Agibot overtakes Unitree for top spot - finance.biggo.com
items.summary: Global shipments of humanoid robots surged by 432% in the first half of the year, with China dominating the market and Agibot surpassing Unitree.

items.title: AgiBot Delivers 20,000th Robot as 300-Plus Units Go to Work at Chimelong Spaceship Park
items.summary: AgiBot delivered its 20,000th robot, an Expedition A3 Ultra, to Chimelong, with over 300 units now deployed for daily work at a Zhuhai park.

items.title: Simate Debuts Simate-beta Physical AI Fast System, Says It Tops RoboDojo Benchmark
items.summary: Simate debuted Simate-beta, a fast-reaction physical AI model that reportedly topped the RoboDojo benchmark with a 33.95 average score. The model was developed using an agent-driven research pipeline.

items.title: Passive-Dynamic-Walking-Inspired Dynamics Guidance for Energy-Efficient Humanoid Locomotion
items.summary: This research investigates dynamics guidance inspired by passive-dynamic walking to discover mechanically economical gait coordination for energy-efficient humanoid locomotion using reinforcement learning.

items.title: Scouting the Dynamics Gap: Test-Time Policy Adaptation via Action-Outcome Feedback
items.summary: This research addresses test-time policy adaptation for robotic policies using action-outcome feedback to adapt to unobserved physical properties and dynamics during deployment.

items.title: KPI: A Promptable Kernel for Physical Interaction on Humanoids
items.summary: This item introduces KPI, a promptable kernel for physical interaction on humanoids, designed to provide more detailed information for whole-body tracking policies beyond simple trajectories.

items.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Manipulation Policies Under Actuator Degradation
items.summary: This research focuses on test-time adaptation of robot manipulation policies to account for actuator degradation, ensuring consistent performance despite real-world hardware changes.

items.title: Design and Validation of an Antagonistic Tendon-Driven Dexterous Robotic Hand with Bidirectional Operation
items.summary: This item describes the design and validation of an antagonistic tendon-driven dexterous robotic hand with bidirectional operation, aiming to improve grasping workspace compared to human-like designs.

items.title: One from Infinity: Actualizing Futures from Pretrained World Models into Robot Actions
items.summary: This research proposes a method to actualize specific, task-conditioned futures from pretrained video world models into executable robot actions, enabling robots to realize desired outcomes.

items.title: FineART: Fine-grained Annotated Robotic Trajectory Dataset and Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Manipulation
items.summary: This item introduces FineART, a fine-grained annotated robotic trajectory dataset, and a vision-language-action model designed to support complex, multi-step bimanual manipulation tasks for robots.

items.title: Trajectory-Level Mode Guidance for Controllable Diffusion-Based Multi-Robot Motion Planning
items.summary: This research introduces a method for controllable multi-robot motion planning using diffusion models, enabling the generation of diverse and feasible trajectory solutions for robot coordination.

items.title: Reactive Real-Time Flow Policies via Asynchronous Distribution Alignment
items.summary: This work proposes a method for achieving reactive, real-time control for generalist robot policies, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, by using asynchronous execution to predict future actions while current ones are carried out.

items.title: Planning Oriented 3D Scene Completion via Coupled TUDF Occupancy Representation Learning from Partial Observations
items.summary: This paper addresses challenges in robotic navigation by improving 3D scene completion from partial observations, using a coupled TUDF occupancy representation for better environmental understanding.

items.title: Learning to Explore Hidden Kinematics for Articulated Object Manipulation
items.summary: This research explores a method for robots to learn and identify the hidden kinematics of articulated objects through interaction, enabling more effective manipulation without restricting action choices.

items.title: A robust single-sensing-element tactile sensor for concurrent pressure and tackiness detection with real-time signal decoupling capability
items.summary: This item presents a new robust tactile sensor designed for humanoid robots' artificial skin, capable of concurrently detecting pressure and tackiness with real-time signal decoupling.

items.title: EquivDP3: A SIM(3)-Invariant Point-Cloud Encoder for Data-Efficient Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: This work introduces EquivDP3, a SIM(3)-invariant point-cloud encoder designed to improve data efficiency for visuomotor policies in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks by generalizing across object poses.

items.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
items.summary: This study investigates reinforcement learning methods to enable cooperative multi-agent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to achieve fine-grained coordination for inter-robot collaboration.

items.title: Executor-aware Candidate Selection via a Feasibility Certificate
items.summary: This paper presents a certificate-based candidate-selection framework that improves motion planning for modular robotic systems by ensuring the planned motions are compatible with the robot's executor.

items.title: OTRetarget: Joint Robot and Object Motion Retargeting via Optimal Transport
items.summary: This research proposes OTRetarget, a method that uses optimal transport to transfer human motion to humanoid robots, adapting for robot morphology while preserving environmental interactions for loco-manipulation tasks.

items.title: Foundation-Model-Guided Topology-Aware Semantic Risk Fields for Manipulation
items.summary: This work presents a foundation-model-guided, topology-aware semantic risk field to enhance robot motion planning, enabling robots to navigate everyday environments by considering context-dependent semantic risks beyond just collision avoidance.

items.title: Where Predictive Supervision Goes Shapes What VLA Policies Learn
items.summary: This research investigates how the application of predictive supervision impacts what Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn, aiming to improve representations that are beneficial for robot control.

items.title: Degeneracy-Orthogonal Geometric Constraints for LiDAR SLAM
items.summary: This research proposes a method using degeneracy-orthogonal geometric constraints to improve LiDAR SLAM for autonomous robot navigation, addressing limitations like unconstrained drift in axially uniform environments.

items.title: LexiconVLA: Learning Reusable Atomic Action Codebooks for Unseen Tasks
items.summary: This work introduces LexiconVLA, a method for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to learn and reuse atomic action codebooks, improving their ability to perform unseen tasks by consistently executing constituent actions across contexts.

items.title: DRHeC: Differentiable Rendering for Hand-Eye Calibration with RGB-Based Gradients
items.summary: This paper presents DRHeC, a new method for differentiable rendering for hand-eye calibration using RGB-based gradients, offering a markerless approach crucial for precision robotic manipulation.

items.title: TaRL: Learning General and Physical Rewards from Tactile Demonstrations
items.summary: This research introduces TaRL, a method for learning general and physical rewards from tactile demonstrations, enabling reinforcement learning agents to acquire complex, contact-rich robotic manipulation behaviors more effectively.

items.title: Spotter: Let the Embodied Model Lead, and the VLM Reflect for It
items.summary: This work explores whether embodied AI models can self-correct from their failures by employing 'Spotter', a system where the embodied model leads and a Vision-Language Model (VLM) reflects on its actions to suggest corrections.

items.title: PreferenceFlow: Test-Time Guidance of Flow-Matching Robot Policies from Human Interventions
items.summary: This research introduces PreferenceFlow, a method for guiding flow-matching robot policies at test-time using human interventions to improve real-world manipulation.

items.title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Flow-driven Multi-Anchor Exploration for Open-Environment Active 3D Mapping
items.summary: This research proposes a flow-driven multi-anchor exploration method for Open-Environment Active 3D Mapping, aiming to improve long-horizon and shortest trajectory exploration for embodied intelligence.

items.title: AeroManip-VLA: Scalable Vision-Language-Action Learning for Aerial Manipulation with RL-Generated Demonstrations
items.summary: This research introduces AeroManip-VLA, a scalable vision-language-action learning approach for aerial manipulators, using RL-generated demonstrations to extend robotic manipulation into 3D workspaces.

items.title: Track-and-Complete: Learning Humanoid Skills from a Single Failed Human Video
items.summary: This research presents Track-and-Complete, a method enabling humanoid robots to learn skills from a single failed human video by leveraging usable trajectory prefixes before task failure.

items.title: ComManip: Overfitting Manipulation Policies to Comfortable Regions
items.summary: This research introduces ComManip, a method to improve robot manipulation policies by overfitting them to "comfortable regions" and reducing reliance on costly large-scale robot demonstrations.

items.title: Beyond Token Importance: Preserving Spatial Scaffolds for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
items.summary: This research proposes a new approach to VLA inference for robotic manipulation that preserves spatial scaffolds beyond individual token importance, improving efficiency by addressing limitations in current pruning strategies.

items.title: All You Need Is Low Fidelity: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real of Learned Robotic Fish Control
items.summary: This research demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for learned robotic fish control, showing that a low-fidelity simulator is sufficient for developing effective controllers for underwater robots.

items.title: BCNav: Bearing-Conditioned Depth Policies for Sound Source Navigation
items.summary: This research presents BCNav, a method using bearing-conditioned depth policies to enable robots to navigate towards sound sources, extending their perception beyond visual fields in unknown environments.

items.title: Multifunctional Locomotion Control of Multi-Jointed BURs with Swimming and gait Capabilities
items.summary: This research focuses on multifunctional locomotion control for multi-jointed biomimetic underwater robots (BURs), enabling them with both swimming and gait capabilities for underwater tasks.

items.title: China Shipped 77.9% of Global Humanoid Robots in First Half - tokenpost.com
items.summary: China accounted for 77.9% of global humanoid robot shipments in the first half of the year.

items.title: Mistral’s new Large 4 trails some Chinese open models in independent tests - Tom's Hardware
items.summary: Mistral's new Large 4 model has been shown to perform behind some Chinese open-source models in recent independent tests.

items.title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Evaluating and Training Autonomous Operator Agents
items.summary: Introduces StoreBench, a live-commerce environment for evaluating and training autonomous operator agents, addressing limitations of static agentic benchmarks.

items.title: How Narrative Wrapping Affects LLM Refusal: A Cross-Language Benchmark and Defense
items.summary: Introduces a cross-language benchmark to measure how narrative wrapping affects the refusal behavior of safety-aligned language models, revealing a vulnerability.

items.title: AgentHorizon: Evaluating Agentic Judges for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Tasks
items.summary: Introduces AgentHorizon, a framework for evaluating the reliability of agentic judges used to assess computer-use agents on long-horizon, multi-application tasks.

items.title: Beyond Imitation: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Peer Review
items.summary: Proposes a framework and benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models as assistants in the scientific peer review process, moving beyond simple imitation.

items.title: OpenProblemBench: Benchmarking AI on Open Problems in the Foundational Theoretical Sciences
items.summary: Introduces OpenProblemBench, a new benchmark comprising 82 unresolved problems from mathematics and theoretical physics, designed to assess AI progress on open scientific challenges.

items.title: GameCommBench: A Unified Benchmark and Type-Aware Evaluation for AI-Generated Game Commentary
items.summary: Introduces GameCommBench, a unified benchmark and type-aware evaluation framework for AI-Generated Game Commentary, addressing fragmentation in existing studies.

items.title: Mine Odyssey: Benchmarking Spatial Agentic Intelligence in the Wild
items.summary: This work focuses on benchmarking spatial agentic intelligence for AI agents by evaluating their ability to explore, update spatial understanding, and adapt actions in unfamiliar physical environments.

items.title: Conversational Task Disambiguation over Tabular Data: Leakage-Aware Formulation, Benchmark Suite, and Training
items.summary: This item introduces a new leakage-aware formulation, benchmark suite, and training methodology specifically for conversational task disambiguation over tabular data.

items.title: Evaluating Rubric Generation with Interventional Transfer
items.summary: This research evaluates the generation of instance-specific rubrics by large language models, proposing an 'Interventional Transfer' method to assess their quality against expert references.

items.title: Amortized Off-Policy Evaluation for LLMs
items.summary: This research focuses on improving amortized off-policy evaluation for Large Language Models to accurately assess candidate models offline before deployment, mitigating issues like distribution shift.

items.title: RH-Detect: A Unified Benchmark for Reward Hacking Detection
items.summary: This item presents RH-Detect, a new unified benchmark designed to systematically detect reward hacking in language model systems by standardizing labels, response formats, and metadata conventions.

items.title: Grammar Concept Annotation at Scale: Deployed Fine-Tuned Small Language Models Outperform Prompted Frontier Models
items.summary: This study demonstrates that deployed fine-tuned small language models outperform prompted frontier models in grammar concept annotation at scale, providing more efficient corrective feedback for second-language acquisition.

items.title: When Citations Mislead? A Claim-Level Benchmark for Legal Hallucination Detection
items.summary: This paper introduces PARCEL, a claim-level benchmark designed to detect legal hallucinations in Large Language Models by checking if generated legal claims are supported by their cited sources.

items.title: SWE-Journey: Towards More Realistic Evaluation of Coding Assistants through Long-Horizon, Multi-Turn Interaction
items.summary: This paper introduces SWE-Journey, a new benchmark designed for more realistic evaluation of coding assistants, which are typically LLM agents. It focuses on long-horizon, multi-turn interactions to better reflect real-world development work compared to existing benchmarks.

items.title: Measuring Cultural Alignment Beyond the Average: A Framework for Evaluating Maternal-Health LLM Interactions in Indian Contexts
items.summary: This paper proposes a new framework to evaluate large language models for cultural alignment in maternal healthcare interactions, focusing on Indian contexts. It aims to assess how well LLMs reflect culturally situated healthcare reasoning beyond factual correctness.

items.title: TRACE: Diagnosing Verifier Brittleness in Agentic Evaluation
items.summary: This paper introduces TRACE, a protocol designed to diagnose verifier brittleness in the evaluation of large language model agents. It aims to clarify whether score changes in agent evaluations reflect capability changes or issues within the evaluation process itself.

items.title: WorldFact-Bench: Beyond Image-Internal Plausibility to Image-World Consistency
items.summary: Presents WorldFact-Bench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate the image-world consistency of generated images, moving beyond mere internal plausibility to assess alignment with real-world facts and rules.

items.title: Using evals to cut AI errors 7x
items.summary: A company used evaluation methods to significantly reduce AI errors by a factor of seven. This demonstrates the practical application of evaluation in improving AI feature performance.

items.title: Scale AI cut 89 tasks from SWE-Bench Pro after an audit found gaming
items.summary: Scale AI removed 89 tasks from its SWE-Bench Pro coding benchmark after an audit revealed instances of 'gaming' by participants. The company then graded its own fix for the benchmark's integrity.

items.title: New site for AI math problems
items.summary: A new website, Erdos Problems AI, has launched to provide a platform for AI to tackle mathematical problems, serving as an evaluation or benchmarking tool.

items.title: 3JSBench: A benchmark for LLM-generated 3D objects
items.summary: A new benchmark called 3JSBench has been introduced for evaluating 3D objects generated by Large Language Models.

items.title: ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini: 56 vs 46 Satisfaction [2026] - tech-insider.org
items.summary: An article compares user satisfaction levels for major AI models including ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, presenting specific satisfaction scores.

items.title: Ecosia drops Mistral AI for open models, citing a 1-year quality gap - PPC Land
items.summary: Ecosia replaced Mistral AI with open models for its search services, citing a one-year quality gap in performance.

items.title: Show HN: AI SRE Arena, an Open Benchmark for AI SRE Agents on Kubernetes
items.summary: AI SRE Arena is presented as a new open benchmark specifically designed for evaluating AI Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) agents operating on Kubernetes.

items.title: Show HN: Jevman – AI decision models play Pac-Man
items.summary: Jevman is a project that tests various AI decision models, including OpenAI's new decisions endpoint, by having them play Pac-Man as a benchmark for fast decision-making.

items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash vs Haiku 5.5 vs Gemini Flash - https://tech-insider.org/
items.summary: This article compares the performance of several AI models, including DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Haiku 5.5, and Gemini Flash.

items.title: Conditional Accuracy Profiles: Diagnosing LLM Judges across Deployment Conditions
items.summary: Conditional Accuracy Profiles (CAP) is introduced as a post-hoc method to diagnose LLM judges, providing a nuanced view of their performance across various deployment conditions rather than a single accuracy number.

items.title: Efficient Best-of-N policy evaluation for inference-time alignment
items.summary: This paper addresses the challenge of efficiently evaluating Best-of-N policies, a common inference-time alignment method, from logged data, particularly under sample-only access.

items.title: Tokka-Bench: Evaluating Tokenizers Across 100 Natural and 20 Programming Languages
items.summary: Tokka-Bench is introduced as an open-source framework to evaluate subword tokenizers for large language models across 100 natural and 20 programming languages using multiple metrics.

items.title: Quad-State Safety Evaluation of Open-Weight Large Language Models on Non-Canonical Inputs
items.summary: This research evaluates the safety of open-weight large language models by assessing their responses to harmful requests containing non-canonical inputs like emojis and altered spellings. It highlights how real-world inputs differ from standard plain text used in typical safety evaluations.

items.title: sk-bench: A Native-First Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Slovak
items.summary: This paper introduces "sk-bench," a new native-first benchmark designed for evaluating large language models in Slovak, a morphologically rich West Slavic language. It comprises 30 datasets across ten skill categories, addressing the omission of Slovak in existing multilingual LLM benchmarks.

items.title: Arctic Questions, Missing Answers: A Dataset and Benchmark for LLM Abstention in Arctic Science
items.summary: This paper introduces ArcticQA, a dataset and benchmark comprising 194 questions from primary Arctic research to evaluate large language models' ability to abstain from answering when no valid option is present. It assesses their sensitivity to answer availability in scientific multiple-choice questions.

items.title: BanglaRhet: Benchmarking Classical and Transformer Models for Rhetorical and Persuasion Detection in Bangla Political Speech
items.summary: This paper introduces BanglaRhet, a new benchmark for evaluating classical and transformer models on rhetorical and persuasion detection in Bangla political speech. It aims to systematically assess model performance in a domain where only sentiment analysis has seen progress.

items.title: RELATE: An Evaluation Framework for measuring Relational Orientation of Large Language Models
items.summary: This paper introduces RELATE, a new evaluation framework designed to measure the relational orientation of large language models, particularly their impact on users' real-world relationships when providing emotional support. It addresses an under-examined aspect beyond safety or empathy.

items.title: Alice: A Large-Scale German Benchmark for Rubric-Based Multi-Dimensional Automatic Short Answer Scoring
items.summary: This paper introduces "Alice", a large-scale German benchmark for rubric-based, multi-dimensional automatic short answer scoring, designed to assess how well students grasp underlying concepts.

items.title: InsClaimBench: Benchmarking Insurance Claim Adjudication Across the Decision Chain
items.summary: This paper introduces InsClaimBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate reasoning-oriented large language models on the complex task of insurance claim adjudication, covering the entire decision chain.

items.title: Pre-training, Reasoning, Benchmarking: X-ray Report Generation on CheXpert Plus Dataset
items.summary: Focuses on pre-training, reasoning, and benchmarking for X-ray report generation in medical AI, utilizing the CheXpert Plus Dataset.

items.title: PanoPed: Beyond Bounding Boxes for Sim-to-Real Panoramic Pedestrian Tracking
items.summary: Introduces PanoPed, a sim-to-real benchmark for pedestrian tracking using full-sphere panoramic cameras, moving beyond traditional bounding box limitations.

items.title: DISRQAD: Diffusion Image Super-Resolution Quality Assessment Dataset and Benchmark
items.summary: Introduces DISRQAD, a subjective-quality dataset and diagnostic benchmark with mean opinion scores for evaluating diffusion-based image super-resolution outputs.

items.title: Google rolls out improved SynthID AI content detector, now available globally
items.summary: Google has rolled out an improved SynthID AI content detector globally, which can now identify AI-generated content from Google, OpenAI, and other sources.

items.title: Google’s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
items.summary: Google has launched a new SynthID website that allows users to verify if media, including images, videos, and audio clips, was generated using AI.

items.title: Google's AI detection website is now available
items.summary: Google's SynthID Detector, an AI detection website, is now available to flag content created with AI tools from various companies including OpenAI and Apple.

items.title: HiPHI: A Large-Scale Benchmark for High-Precision Human Motion and Object Interaction
items.summary: A new large-scale motion capture dataset called HiPHI is introduced as a benchmark for humanoid robot learning. It demonstrates how policies trained on this dataset can be transferred to a real humanoid robot.

items.title: Benchmarking Jev against no-CoT LLMs
items.summary: A new benchmark evaluated Jev 1.13, a non-autoregressive model, against other LLMs on specific tasks like the ThinkFast suite and Neel Nanda’s NCRI, reporting its performance and capabilities.

items.title: New Research by LLM Scout Reveals ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity Disagree on Brand Mentions in More Than One in Four Evaluation Queries - Yahoo Finance
items.summary: New research by LLM Scout indicates that major language models frequently disagree on brand mentions in over a quarter of evaluation queries.

items.title: How Does Mistral Large 4 Compare To Its Competitors? - AI Magazine
items.summary: The article discusses how Mistral Large 4 compares against its competitors, evaluating its performance in the AI landscape.

items.title: Sample-Optimal Estimation of the Fr\'echet Inception Distance
items.summary: This research investigates the sample-optimal estimation of the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), a widely used metric for evaluating generative models, focusing on its sample complexity and finite-sample bias.

items.title: CLM-as-a-Judge: Evaluating an Open Contrastive Decision Model on Public Judge Benchmarks
items.summary: This paper evaluates an open contrastive decision model, CLM-as-a-Judge (CLM-v0.1-8B), on public judge benchmarks, revealing its performance is statistically similar to random chance on several of them.

items.title: Benchmarking Time Series Foundation Models for Load Forecasting Under Covariate Uncertainty
items.summary: This item focuses on benchmarking Time Series Foundation Models for short-term load forecasting under covariate uncertainty. It evaluates their effectiveness in real-world scenarios for reliable power system operation.

items.title: JudgeMoE: Distributional Aggregation for LLM-as-a-Judge
items.summary: This introduces JudgeMoE, a lightweight aggregator that improves LLM-as-a-Judge systems by using distributional aggregation to fuse cached judge score distributions, retaining uncertainty information often lost in scalar compression.

items.title: CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets
items.summary: This presents CroissantMiner for automated extraction and validation of Croissant metadata for ML datasets, along with the first benchmark to enable end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction.

items.title: HouseholdBench: Evaluating Large Language Models as Predictors of Household Economic Behavior
items.summary: This introduces HouseholdBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate the capability of large language models (LLMs) in predicting household economic behavior across various settings and changing conditions.

items.title: Does Steering Break Your Model? A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Suite for LLM Steering Methods
items.summary: This introduces a multi-dimensional evaluation suite designed to assess the effectiveness and potential unintended side effects of LLM steering methods, ensuring robust and controlled model behavior.

items.title: Rethinking Faithfulness in LLMs: A Pairwise Context-Sensitive Perspective
items.summary: Proposes rethinking faithfulness in Large Language Models (LLMs) through a pairwise context-sensitive perspective, aiming to improve evaluations of how models adhere to provided context.

items.title: The Labeling Problem in Hallucination Detection Benchmarks: An Empirical Evaluation
items.summary: Empirically evaluates the "labeling problem" within hallucination detection benchmarks for Large Language Models, examining issues in how these evaluation datasets are constructed.

items.title: Penalty-Framed No-Valid-Option MCQA: Analyzing LLM Abstention under Invalid Choices
items.summary: This research analyzes large language model abstention when faced with multiple-choice questions containing no valid options, proposing a method to evaluate LLM behavior in such scenarios.

items.title: Language Unalignability: Why Some Concepts Resist Cross-Cultural Benchmark Evaluation
items.summary: This paper critiques the implicit Translation-Isomorphism Assumption in current cross-cultural benchmark evaluations of multilingual Large Language Models, highlighting why some concepts resist alignability.

items.title: Medical Image Alignment Assessment as a Test of Generalist Visual Reasoning in Frontier Multimodal Models
items.summary: This research proposes using medical image alignment assessment as a novel test to evaluate the generalist visual reasoning capabilities of frontier multimodal large language models.

items.title: Event Cameras for Melt-Pool Monitoring in Additive Manufacturing: A Benchmark and a Cross-Machine Transfer Analysis
items.summary: This research introduces a new public benchmark dataset for melt-pool monitoring in additive manufacturing using event cameras, alongside a cross-machine transfer analysis.

items.title: PlaySuite: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Interactive Visual Intelligence
items.summary: PlaySuite is introduced as a large-scale benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal foundation models on interactive visual intelligence, assessing their competence in dynamic environments over extended time horizons beyond static perception and reasoning.

items.title: Towards benchmarking Western Bluebird detection in the wild
items.summary: This work addresses the challenges of benchmarking Western Bluebird detection in natural environments, highlighting issues like small object size, background clutter, and the scarcity of large-scale datasets for evaluation.

items.title: BiGym 2.0: Benchmarking Learned and Agent-Developed Policies for Humanoid Household Manipulation
items.summary: BiGym 2.0 is introduced as an adaptation of BiGym, providing a benchmark suite for evaluating learned and agent-developed policies for humanoid household manipulation tasks on the Unitree G1 robot.

items.title: Nine Trials to Recover: A Reproducible Benchmark for Repertoire-Free Soft-Robot Damage Adaptation
items.summary: Researchers present a reproducible benchmark protocol for evaluating repertoire-free soft-robot damage adaptation and recovery over nine online trials.

items.title: Benchmark Firm Gives Mistral Large 4 Preview a 38 Intelligence Score - Unite.AI
items.summary: A benchmark firm has assigned an intelligence score of 38 to the preview version of Mistral Large 4, evaluating its performance.

items.title: Mistral Large 4 on Artificial Analysis: Eighth Among Open Models - www.trendingtopics.eu
items.summary: Mistral Large 4 is ranked eighth among open models on Artificial Analysis, highlighting its performance and comparison against other AI models on an evaluation platform.

items.title: TasteVal: Measuring the Experimental Research Taste of AI Systems Against Human Experts
items.summary: A new benchmark called TasteVal is introduced to measure the 'experimental research taste' of AI systems by evaluating their ability to select problems, design experiments, and interpret results.

items.title: How funny are the frontier AI models?
items.summary: The article presents an experiment evaluating the humor capabilities of frontier AI models, concluding that their ability to generate jokes is improving over time.

items.title: Can you predict cross-propensity spillover?
items.summary: A research group conducted an experiment to measure cross-propensity spillover, evaluating how fine-tuning for one propensity impacts others across 29 propensities.

items.title: Dalian University of Technology's VA-Bench: Top Multimodal Models Finish Only Half of Robot Tasks
items.summary: Dalian University of Technology introduced VA-Bench, a new benchmark to test multimodal models on robot-arm tasks, revealing that top models like Qwen3.8-max only complete about half of the tasks.

items.title: U.S.-China AI Gap Narrows to 3% as DeepSeek Matches Anthropic's Performance - finance.biggo.com
items.summary: A report indicates the US-China AI gap has narrowed to 3%, with DeepSeek's AI model matching Anthropic's performance.

items.title: US-China AI gap narrows to record-low 3%, led by DeepSeek: Report | DeepSeek’s V4.1 Flash ranked 6th in Sept | Inshorts - Inshorts
items.summary: A report indicates the US-China AI gap has narrowed to 3%, with DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash model ranking 6th in September.

items.title: Right Order, Wrong Scale: Auditing LLM Judges for Occupational AI Measurement
items.summary: This paper evaluates the reliability of LLM judges in assessing AI outputs for workplace requirements, noting that agreement on rankings doesn't equate to agreement on acceptance rates. It introduces O*NET-BENCH, an audit suite derived from worker ratings, to address this.

items.title: Open-Endedness Bench: Measuring Epistemic Process from Agent Records
items.summary: This paper introduces 'Open-Endedness Bench,' a new benchmark for measuring the epistemic process of AI agents performing open-ended research tasks. It evaluates agents based on their execution logs rather than just final outputs.

items.title: TasteBench: Multimodal Benchmark for Sensory Prediction, from Molecules to Sustainable Foods
items.summary: This paper introduces TasteBench, a multimodal benchmark designed for sensory prediction, spanning from molecular properties to the taste of sustainable foods. It aims to provide computational proxies to accelerate discovery in areas like novel food development.

items.title: Time Series Forecasting Benchmarks Need Scenario-Grounded Stress Testing
items.summary: This research argues for the necessity of scenario-grounded stress testing in time series forecasting benchmarks, rather than relying solely on low held-out error. It highlights the limitations of current evaluation methods in assessing robustness.

items.title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning
items.summary: This work introduces Ego2World, a benchmark that compiles egocentric cooking videos into executable planning environments, allowing for the testing and evaluation of agents in complex, real-world activities under partial observation.

items.title: MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0
items.summary: This release introduces the MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0, an end-to-end methodology for evaluating the robustness of large AI systems against prompt-based jailbreaks that bypass safety safeguards.

items.title: TRACE: A Reproducible Benchmark for Electricity Price Forecasting with Official Operational Text
items.summary: TRACE is introduced as a reproducible benchmark for electricity price forecasting that incorporates official operational textual context, addressing the limitations of existing numerical-only benchmarks. It aims to better evaluate the value of textual information in forecasting.

items.title: Co-design Gym: A Unified Benchmark for Embodiment-Policy Co-optimization
items.summary: Introduces Co-design Gym, a unified benchmark for evaluating embodiment-policy co-optimization in domains like robotics, games, and multi-agent systems, focusing on finding optimal behaviors.

items.title: Are you Synthesizing or Recalling? Evaluating LLMs on Algorithmic Code Retrieval
items.summary: Proposes evaluating Large Language Models on algorithmic code retrieval to distinguish whether they are synthesizing new code or recalling existing knowledge, addressing the opaque nature of current code generation pipelines.

items.title: OpenGameEval: Benchmarking Agentic Programming and Exploration in a Stateful Game Engine
items.summary: OpenGameEval is introduced as a new benchmark and evaluation framework for agentic game development in Roblox Studio, allowing language models to act as agents in stateful game-engine sessions.

items.title: HakemBench: A Turkish Benchmark of Typed Decisions
items.summary: HakemBench is released as a new open-source Turkish benchmark for evaluating models on typed decision-making, containing over 2,300 items with choice, yes/no, and scoring questions.

items.title: Finding the Move Is Not Winning the Game: XiangqiBench for Closed-Loop Evaluation of LLM Agents
items.summary: XiangqiBench is introduced as a new executable benchmark for the closed-loop evaluation of LLM agents in Chinese chess, assessing their ability to execute plans and achieve verified outcomes against an opponent.

items.title: CUEing User Simulators: Calibrated User Embeddings for Multi-Turn Benchmarking
items.summary: This paper proposes CUEing User Simulators, utilizing calibrated user embeddings, to enhance multi-turn benchmarking of AI agents by providing more ecologically valid and failure-aligned interactive evaluations.

items.title: Evaluating Multi-Dimensional Generalization of Large Language Models in Temporal Extraction Tasks
items.summary: This research focuses on evaluating the multi-dimensional generalization of large language models in temporal extraction tasks, highlighting challenges in assessing reliability beyond in-domain performance.

items.title: TPBench: A Turning-Point Benchmark for Dialogue Compression
items.summary: TPBench is a new benchmark for evaluating dialogue compression, specifically designed to identify 'turning-point eviction' where critical conversational shifts are lost despite overall retention.

items.title: AptMQL-Bench: From Text-to-SQL to Text-to-MQL via Access-Pattern Schema Design and Data-Preserving Migration
items.summary: AptMQL-Bench is introduced as a new benchmark for Text-to-MQL tasks, enabling natural-language interfaces for document databases like MongoDB and supporting evaluation of query language translation.

items.title: Automatic Evaluation of Mental Health Stigma in Online Communication
items.summary: Researchers propose a theory-grounded benchmark for the automatic evaluation of mental health stigma in online communication, addressing the complexity of identifying explicit and subtle forms of stigma.

items.title: Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge Beyond Score Alignment: A Psychometric Analysis of Residual Judging Difficulty
items.summary: This paper presents a psychometric analysis of 'LLM-as-a-Judge' systems, moving beyond simple score alignment to evaluate residual judging difficulty and identify evaluation cases challenging to both humans and LLMs.

items.title: Evaluating VQA in Vision Language Models using Cooperative Principles
items.summary: This study evaluates Vision Language Models' performance in Visual Question Answering (VQA) when questions violate Grice's maxims, using VLMs to generate ambiguous or false question modifiers.

items.title: OLMo-Detect: A Multi-Stage, Confounder-Controlled Benchmark for Membership Inference on Large Language Models
items.summary: OLMo-Detect is introduced as a multi-stage, confounder-controlled benchmark designed to evaluate membership inference methods on large language models. It aims to improve the assessment of whether a given text sample was part of an LLM's training data.

items.title: StanceEval 2026: The Second Stance Detection Shared Task
items.summary: StanceEval 2026 is announced as the second shared task focused on stance detection in Arabic social media text. The goal is for participating systems to identify a writer's stance toward a given topic as Favor, Against, or Neutral.

items.title: To Jev or Not? Evaluating the Accuracy and Efficiency of Structured Decision Models for Hate-Speech Moderation
items.summary: This paper evaluates the accuracy and efficiency of structured decision models used for hate-speech moderation. It addresses the challenges posed by LLMs in producing harmful content.

items.title: SyntaxBench: A Statistical Diagnostic Framework for Character-Level Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.summary: This paper introduces SyntaxBench, a diagnostic benchmark and statistical evaluation framework for character-level reasoning in large language models. It aims to improve the evaluation of syntactic accuracy where small errors are critical.

items.title: Writerslogic at PAN 2026: Process over Content for Robust Detection under Domain Shift
items.summary: This paper describes the Writerslogic systems developed for three PAN at CLEF 2026 shared tasks, including Reasoning Trajectory Detection and Generative AI Detection. The systems focus on feature robustness under domain shift for these evaluation tasks.

items.title: EditHero: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Part-Level 3D Editing and Vibe Modeling
items.summary: This paper introduces EditHero, presented as the first benchmark for long-horizon, part-level 3D editing and vibe modeling. It addresses the need for evaluating methods that handle sequences of revisions in 3D asset creation.

items.title: Physical AI Smart Spaces: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-Camera 3D Perception in Smart Spaces
items.summary: Physical AI Smart Spaces is introduced as a large-scale benchmark dataset providing over 280 hours of multi-class, multi-camera 3D perception data for indoor smart spaces like warehouses and hospitals.

items.title: Capturing Dynamics: The 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset
items.summary: This paper introduces the 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset, designed to provide data for the estimation and analysis of facial expression intensity, moving beyond traditional frame-level 2D representations.

items.title: Seeing, Saying, but Not Using: From Reportable Spatial Facts to Usable States in Multimodal Large Language Models
items.summary: This work introduces SpaceConflict, a benchmark with 23,196 inputs, to study why multimodal large language models often report spatial facts correctly but fail to utilize them in subsequent reasoning.

items.title: TerraVis: Towards Evaluation of World-Grounded Visual Consistency in Text-to-Image Generation via MLLM Workflows
items.summary: TerraVis proposes a new MLLM workflow-based approach to evaluate the world-grounded visual consistency of text-to-image generation models, identifying issues like physically implausible interactions.

items.title: Beyond Single Videos: Benchmarking and Active Evidence Seeking for E-Commerce Cross-Video Reasoning
items.summary: This work introduces a new benchmark and active evidence seeking framework for E-commerce cross-video reasoning, evaluating multimodal models' ability to compare and understand information across multiple videos.

items.title: A Benchmark for Spatially Grounded Gesture Generation
items.summary: This paper proposes a new benchmark for spatially grounded gesture generation, providing a common framework to evaluate how well generated gestures anchor language to the environment in shared space.

items.title: ManiPhysicsBench: Physics-Based Assessment of Object Preservation in VLA Manipulation
items.summary: Introduces ManiPhysicsBench, a new benchmark for assessing vision-language-action (VLA) models on object preservation during manipulation tasks, evaluating material properties and 3D meshes.

items.title: DexJoCo-X: Benchmarking Action Representations for Multi-Hand Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: Introduces DexJoCo-X, a new benchmark designed to evaluate and compare different action representations for multi-hand dexterous robotic manipulation, facilitating scalable cross-embodiment learning.

items.title: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max and ZTE's Nebula Tie for Top Chinese Spot in SuperCLUE Embodied Brain Ranking
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max and ZTE's Nebula-EmbodiedBrain have tied for the top Chinese spot on SuperCLUE's September embodied brain leaderboard with scores of 77.48.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra vs GPT-6.1 Sol vs Gemini 4 Argon vs Claude Fable 5.1: Which Frontier Model Fits Which Job
items.summary: The article compares several hypothetical frontier AI models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Argon, and Claude Fable 5.1, evaluating their suitability and performance for various tasks like computer use, legal work, and coding.

items.title: MAI-Transcribe vs Grok vs Qwen-Audio Speech AI [2026] - tech-insider.org
items.summary: The article compares the performance and capabilities of various Speech AI systems, including MAI-Transcribe, Grok, and Qwen-Audio.

items.title: An AI couldn’t beat humans at StarCraft, so it decided to cheat
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 AI-made bots competed in StarCraft against human-made bots in StarSkirmish, tying as the best AI performers but not surpassing the top human bot.

items.title: The Saw Test – Live LLM Torture Chamber
items.summary: The "Saw Test" is introduced as a method to evaluate and test the limits of large language models (LLMs).

items.title: E2E: The open source AI testing framework
items.summary: E2E is introduced as an open-source framework designed for testing and evaluating artificial intelligence systems end-to-end.

items.title: A Key-Position Confound in no-cot-bench (and implications for interpreting looped transformers)
items.summary: A confound is identified in the 'no-cot-bench' benchmark related to prompt key positioning, which significantly affects the measured reasoning depth of models like GPT-6.1 Sol. This finding impacts how current benchmark performances are interpreted.

items.title: AI beats licensed accountants on speed and accuracy, but still can't close the books without supervision
items.summary: A Mercor study indicates that current AI models surpass licensed accountants in speed and accuracy for structured tasks, though they still require human oversight and struggle with the APEX Benchmark.

items.title: Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying
items.summary: Build2SPARQL is presented as a large-scale benchmark dataset for evaluating the translation of natural language questions into SPARQL queries within building automation systems that use knowledge graphs.

items.title: Benchmarking Prompt Optimization of Large Language Models With Chess
items.summary: This item proposes a new method for benchmarking prompt optimization of Large Language Models using chess, addressing challenges in evaluating advanced LLM capabilities and preventing benchmark saturation.

items.title: Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation
items.summary: This research audits the configuration fragility in text-to-3D evaluation, demonstrating how render settings and caption wording can significantly alter leaderboard rankings even with fixed generated scenes.

items.title: Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluations (OB-CAIE) Methodology
items.summary: The Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluation (OB-CAIE) methodology is developed to improve the scientific rigor, testing coverage, and reproducibility of AI evaluation environments.

items.title: Science or Slop?: Benchmarking and Mitigating Scientific Slop in AI-Generated Papers
items.summary: This paper discusses benchmarking and mitigating 'scientific slop' in AI-generated papers, identifying patterns that evade existing detectors and proposing methods to address the issue of low-quality academic content.

items.title: Legal Research Bench: Measuring End-to-End Reliability in Long-Horizon Legal Research Agents
items.summary: Legal Research Bench is presented as a tool for measuring the end-to-end reliability of long-horizon legal research agents, designed to evaluate their ability to perform complex, retrieval-intensive legal workflows.

items.title: CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science
items.summary: CompMat-Bench is introduced as a benchmark specifically designed for evaluating AI agents in computational materials science, addressing the practical challenges of repeating expensive simulations for agent evaluation.

items.title: Incident-Arena: Getting agents to the last nine of reliability
items.summary: Incident-Arena is proposed as an evaluation platform to improve the reliability of AI coding agents, particularly for their performance in production incident response and agentic site-reliability-engineering (SRE) tasks.

items.title: Agent Evaluation Reliability: More Tasks Won't (Always) Fix An Agent Leaderboard
items.summary: This paper investigates the reliability of agent evaluations, showing that simply adding more tasks does not always improve agent leaderboards and that results are dependent on evaluation conditions.

items.title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
items.summary: This paper introduces Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for evaluating LLM reasoning in scientific AI applications, addressing the issue of factual inaccuracies in areas like biomedical question answering.

items.title: R-GroundBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for R-Group Groundingin Markush Molecular Editing
items.summary: R-GroundBench is a diagnostic benchmark introduced to evaluate AI agents' ability in 'R-Group Grounding' within Markush molecular editing, a crucial aspect for molecular understanding and design.

items.title: ReLiveGym: Evaluating Long-Lived Agents over Weeks of Replayed Reality
items.summary: This paper introduces ReLiveGym, a framework designed for evaluating long-lived LLM agents over weeks of replayed reality, addressing the challenge of persistent monitoring and adaptation.

items.title: Kepler: Auditable World Models for ARC-AGI-3
items.summary: This paper presents Kepler, an open-source harness for auditing and validating agent behaviors and inferred world models in interactive environments like ARC-AGI-3.

items.title: Finding the Right Fit: Model-Harness Interactions across Agent Tasks
items.summary: This study evaluates 66 configurations of language models and agent harnesses (e.g., OpenHands, DeepSeek Harness) to understand their interactions and performance across various agent tasks.

items.title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Preference Distributions
items.summary: This research systematically evaluates the structure and reliability of preference distributions generated by Large Language Models when used as probabilistic generators for simulation and data synthesis.

items.title: MM-FinEval: A Multi-Task Multimodal Benchmark for Real-World Financial Forecasting
items.summary: MM-FinEval is introduced as a new multi-task multimodal benchmark for real-world financial forecasting, specifically designed to evaluate models' reasoning over complex corporate disclosures and market signals from earnings calls.

items.title: ChartDensity-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Numerical Data Reconstruction under Visual Density
items.summary: ChartDensity-Bench is a new benchmark designed to evaluate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on their ability to reconstruct numerical data from visually dense scientific charts.

items.title: Video-Index: A Curated Meta-Benchmark for Video Understanding
items.summary: This paper introduces "Video-Index," a curated meta-benchmark for video understanding, along with an "attack pyramid" to audit existing video benchmarks for shortcut attacks.

items.title: VIEScore2: Unified Image Evaluation with Spatially Grounded Explanations
items.summary: This paper introduces "VIEScore2," a unified evaluator for image generation and editing tasks that provides both a scalar quality score and spatially grounded explanations for its assessments.

items.title: Bounded-Fidelity Sim-as-Demo-Stage: Mocap Handoff for Governance Benchmarks
items.summary: This research introduces a "bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage" and mocap handoff for governance benchmarking of LLM-driven robots, focusing on evaluating their admission/policy pipelines.

items.title: Does Continual Imitation Learning Remain Grounded? A Language-Perturbed Benchmark for Robotic Task Retention
items.summary: This paper introduces a Language-Perturbed Benchmark to evaluate whether continual imitation learning in robots remains grounded in language, even as they learn new skills without forgetting old ones.

items.title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
items.summary: This empirical study introduces the Embodied Agent Arena to evaluate the readiness of frontier vision-language model (VLM) agents to function as robot generalists, assessing their ability to perform complete robotic tasks.

items.title: Is Success All You Need? Investigating the Impact of Input Perturbations on VLA Behaviour in Tabletop Manipulation Tasks
items.summary: This research investigates the impact of input perturbations on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model behavior in tabletop manipulation tasks, evaluating their robustness beyond simple task success rates.

items.title: AI Benchmark Scores: Why 82% is actually 57%
items.summary: An article critically analyzes AI benchmark scores, explaining how reported percentages might not accurately reflect true performance.

items.title: Opus 5.5 loves to tell you ‘this matters’ (and other AI writing tells)
items.summary: An analysis of Opus 5.5 found that it uses the word 'dependable' 23 times more often than human samples, highlighting distinct AI writing patterns.

items.title: HoneyBench - A general benchmark for reward hacking in frontier models
items.summary: "HoneyBench" has been released as a new benchmark designed to identify and evaluate "reward hacking" behaviors in frontier AI models. It features nine "honeypot" challenges that elicit antisocial examples from major AI models.

items.title: AI Visibility Benchmark for Law Firms and Attorneys Finds - GlobeNewswire
items.summary: A new 'AI Visibility Benchmark' has been developed to measure and compare the presence and impact of artificial intelligence among law firms and attorneys. This introduces a new evaluation method.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon Posts the Lowest Hallucination Rate of Any Top AI Model - Startup Fortune
items.summary: Gemini 4 Argon has reportedly achieved the lowest hallucination rate among top AI models, indicating its performance in generating accurate and reliable content.

items.title: ArgGYM: A Procedural, Engine-Verified Benchmark for Structured Defeasible Reasoning
items.summary: This paper introduces ArgGYM, a new procedural and engine-verified benchmark designed to evaluate the structured defeasible reasoning capabilities of large language models. It provides a robust environment for assessing AI reasoning in complex logical tasks.

items.title: NAQD Env: A benchmark for selective withdrawal in language agents
items.summary: This paper introduces NAQD-Env, a new synthetic environment designed as a benchmark for evaluating selective withdrawal capabilities in language agents. It assesses an agent's ability to revise planned actions and manage work when conditions change.

items.title: VAmoS Part Deux: Harder, More Realistic Voice-Agent Simulation
items.summary: This paper introduces VAmoS Energy, a new benchmark for voice agents that simulates realistic challenges like multiple requests, background speech, and impatient customers in utility billing scenarios. It provides a more robust evaluation environment for voice AI in production.

items.title: Sense and Sensitivity: Benchmarking LLM Clinical Triage Recommendations with Physician Experts
items.summary: This research benchmarks LLM clinical triage recommendations against physician experts to evaluate reliability under realistic variations in clinical text. It assesses LLM performance and sensitivity to text perturbations in a healthcare setting.

items.title: ChartRevise: A Dataset and Evaluation Protocol for Exact Chart Editing via Code
items.summary: This item introduces ChartRevise, a new dataset and evaluation protocol designed to measure the precision and effectiveness of systems that edit charts by modifying their underlying code.

items.title: AgBench: Agentic AI Benchmarks for Personal AI Devices
items.summary: This article introduces AgBench, a new benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the performance and capabilities of agentic AI systems running on personal AI devices.

items.title: Talk2Agent: Benchmarking Voice Interfaces for Text Agents
items.summary: This paper introduces Talk2Agent, a method for benchmarking voice interfaces for large language model (LLM) agents, focusing on how transcription errors affect task performance.

items.title: Halluscoring 2026: The first shared task on llms hallucination detection and answer verification
items.summary: HalluScoring 2026 is introduced as the first shared task focused on evaluating hallucination detection and factual verification in Arabic question answering for large language models.

items.title: The Backdrop Exposes What the World Around an Agent Costs It
items.summary: BACKDROP is presented as a new evaluation framework for AI agents, designed to assess their capabilities in dynamic, real-world environments where external factors can change.

items.title: KlinikeBench: Evaluating Language Models Beyond Diagnostic Accuracy
items.summary: KlinikeBench is introduced as a new benchmark for evaluating language models in clinical settings, focusing on capabilities beyond mere diagnostic accuracy.

items.title: MedKIT: Evaluating Knowledge Integration and Generalization in Large Language Models
items.summary: MedKIT proposes an evaluation framework for assessing how large language models integrate and generalize evolving knowledge, particularly in the medical domain, highlighting limitations of current factual recall-focused evaluations. It aims to address safety risks from outdated knowledge.

items.title: Beyond Oracle Communication: Benchmarking Interactive Intent Alignment Under Miscommunication and Evolving User Intent
items.summary: This work proposes new benchmarks to evaluate LLM agents' ability to align with user intent in interactive, long-horizon tasks, moving beyond the unrealistic "oracle communication" assumption. It specifically focuses on scenarios involving miscommunication and evolving user intent.

items.title: StreamDecisionBench: Evaluating Decisions in Force on Evolving Language Streams
items.summary: StreamDecisionBench is a new benchmark for evaluating the decision-making capabilities of language models when they operate as embedded components within programs processing evolving language streams. It assesses their ability to make and adapt decisions as evidence changes over time.

items.title: A Missing Piece for Trustworthy AI Reviewers: From Benchmarking Rhetorical Robustness to SciCore Review
items.summary: This paper introduces the concept of Rhetorical Robustness and proposes benchmarking methods to evaluate AI reviewers' stability across content-preserving rewrites. It aims to ensure trustworthy AI reviewers are not swayed by rhetorical optimization over scientific merit.

items.title: ViLegalExpert: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Vietnamese Legal Retrieval and Question Answering from Real-World Consultations
items.summary: ViLegalExpert is a large-scale benchmark introduced for evaluating Vietnamese legal retrieval and question-answering systems using real-world consultations. It aims to improve the trustworthiness of legal AI by providing comprehensive, grounded assessment.

items.title: Team MSU GenText-Forensics Challenge 2026 Technical Report
items.summary: This is a technical report for the ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge, which focuses on evaluating systems for detecting advanced document text forgery targeting OCR and LLM pipelines.

items.title: Hard-Region Supervision: #1 on the Waymo Open Dataset 2D Video Panoptic Segmentation Leaderboard
items.summary: This paper details the winning entry for the Waymo Open Dataset 2D Video Panoptic Segmentation Challenge, employing a method called hard-region supervision to achieve top performance on the leaderboard.

items.title: Fiatlux: A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Humanoid Ladder Climbing and Light-Bulb Replacement
items.summary: This paper introduces Fiatlux, a new long-horizon benchmark designed to evaluate humanoid robots on tasks involving ladder climbing and dexterous light-bulb replacement.

items.title: TALK-Dem: Benchmarking Embodied Task Planning under Dementia-Associated Communication Patterns
items.summary: This paper introduces TALK-Dem, a benchmark designed to evaluate LLM-driven robot task planners when interacting with users exhibiting dementia-associated communication patterns.

items.title: TrafficSignBench: Rule-Centric Closed-Loop Evaluation of Traffic-Sign Compliance in Autonomous Driving
items.summary: This paper introduces TrafficSignBench, a rule-centric closed-loop evaluation benchmark for assessing the traffic-sign compliance of autonomous driving planners.

items.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Skill-Level Memory for Partially Observable Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: This research paper introduces a benchmark and method for enhancing skill-level memory for partially observable robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: DrivingBench: Can Vision-Language Models Drive a Toyota Corolla?
items.summary: This paper introduces DrivingBench, the first benchmark to evaluate the ability of general-purpose vision-language models to drive a real car.

items.title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon Matches GPT-6 Astra on Intelligence Benchmarks at 60% the Cost - news.lavx.hu
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Argon model reportedly performs comparably to GPT-6 Astra on intelligence benchmarks while being 60% more cost-effective.

items.title: Principles for Embedded Evaluations
items.summary: A new blog post discusses 'Principles for Embedded Evaluations,' outlining methods for evaluating frontier AI development as proposed by leading AI companies.

items.title: More Programs or More Rolls? Separating Coverage from Specialization in LLM Harnesses
items.summary: This work introduces a controlled evaluation method to distinguish between answer coverage and task specialization in LLM 'harnesses' or systems.

items.title: PowerZooJax: A JAX-based Power System Benchmark for Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This paper introduces PowerZooJax, a new JAX-based benchmark designed for evaluating reinforcement learning algorithms in safety-critical power system operations.

items.title: GeoOutageBench: Benchmarking Ambiguity-aware, Ontology-grounded Geospatiotemporal KGQA for Multimodal Power Outage and Resilience Analysis
items.summary: GeoOutageBench is presented as a new benchmark for assessing LLM-based knowledge graph question answering for multimodal power outage and resilience analysis.

items.title: OTROPE: Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-policy Evaluation for Large Language Models
items.summary: OTROPE proposes an optimal transport-based robust off-policy evaluation method for large language models, aiming to reliably assess LLM performance using limited human-labeled data.

items.title: CheatBench: Measuring Reward Gaming in AI Agents
items.summary: CheatBench is introduced as a benchmark to measure reward gaming in AI agents, identifying instances where agents achieve high rewards by exploiting system vulnerabilities or accessing unauthorized information.

items.title: MAADBench: The Refreshable Paradigm for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: MAADBench is presented as a new benchmark paradigm designed to facilitate systematic anomaly detection in LLM-based multi-agent systems, which is challenging due to their evolving nature.

items.title: Automated Evaluation of Multi-Turn Dialogues in In-Car Conversational Assistants
items.summary: Focuses on the automated evaluation of multi-turn dialogues in in-car conversational assistants. The research addresses challenges in ensuring reliability for these AI systems due to complex interactions and safety constraints.

items.title: How to Run Statistics over LLM Judges and Trust the Results: Calibrated Inference for Small-Sample AI Evaluation with evalstats
items.summary: Presents "evalstats," a framework for calibrated inference when evaluating AI using LLM judges and small samples. The work aims to provide reliable statistical methods for computing confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, and judge-bias corrections in AI evaluation.

items.title: $\tau$-Multilingual: Benchmarking Voice Agents Across Languages
items.summary: Introduces $\tau$-Multilingual, an extension of the $\tau$-Voice benchmark designed for evaluating voice agents across multiple languages. It includes native-speaker review and evaluation of generated language and spoken output in Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, and Mandarin.

items.title: CruxBench: A Benchmark of Information Discovery
items.summary: CruxBench is introduced as a new benchmark for large language models, designed to evaluate their ability to identify and decompose complex problems into relevant subquestions for information discovery.

items.title: CineSubBench: Evaluating LLMs on Long-Form Narrative and Cultural Understanding from Multilingual Movie Subtitles
items.summary: CineSubBench is introduced as a new benchmark to evaluate large language models on long-form narrative comprehension and cultural understanding using multilingual movie subtitles.

items.title: CoVLM-Bench: A Real-World Benchmark for Cooperative Driving Question Answering and Planning
items.summary: CoVLM-Bench is presented as a new real-world benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language Models in cooperative driving scenarios, specifically for question answering and planning.

items.title: AerialDojo-200K: A Large-Scale Benchmark Suite for Open-World Aerial Object-Goal Search
items.summary: AerialDojo-200K is introduced as a large-scale benchmark suite designed for evaluating open-world aerial object-goal search capabilities of aerial agents in unstructured three-dimensional environments.

items.title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Synapse Detection and Proofreading in Connectomics
items.summary: This work benchmarks 21 vision-language models on synapse detection and proofreading tasks using electron microscopy images in connectomics, evaluating their performance in a medical application.

items.title: Foresight at the Event Boundary: Evaluating Physical Prediction in Video World Models
items.summary: This paper evaluates the physical prediction capabilities of video world models, analyzing current evaluation methods and their focus on reference similarity and physical-law consistency.

items.title: Beyond Legibility: Benchmarking Visual Text Rendering and In-Place Editing in Unified Video Generation
items.summary: This work introduces a benchmark for evaluating visual text rendering and in-place editing capabilities in unified video generation, focusing on text legibility and temporal stability.

items.title: Scaling Video Generation for Reasoning: At What Cost?
items.summary: This study investigates the reasoning capabilities and computational cost of scaled video generation models using a controlled benchmark involving predicting Rubik's Cube moves.

items.title: VLM4Cluster: Benchmarking Deep Clustering In the Era of Vision-Language Pre-training
items.summary: This work presents VLM4Cluster, a benchmark for evaluating deep clustering methods in the context of vision-language pre-training and language-assisted image clustering.

items.title: LIBERO-MAX: Do Robot Policies Adapt When the World Changes?
items.summary: This item introduces LIBERO-MAX, which investigates how robot policies adapt to changes in the environment, highlighting limitations of current simulation robustness benchmarks in evaluating temporal challenges.

items.title: RoboChrono: A Real Robot Benchmark for Streaming Task Understanding
items.summary: This item introduces RoboChrono, a new real robot benchmark comprising 39 scenarios and 34,713 evaluation instances, designed to assess models' ability to understand ongoing robot manipulation tasks based on visual observations and interaction history.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Sol nearly matches the no-CoT performance of GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: GPT-6.1 Sol demonstrated significantly improved performance on a task suite, nearly matching the capabilities of GPT-6 Astra in a direct model comparison.

items.title: Alibaba Qwen Releases Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an 8-Step 7B Image Model
